**ChatGPT** *(8/13/2026, 1:06:36 AM)*

可以，而且我建议你不要把它设计成简单的：

```text
IP -> 查是不是 Cloudflare IP -> 是/否
```

而是设计成一个**多信号 Cloudflare Reverse Proxy Detector**。

Cloudflare 官方说明里，开启代理的域名会把 DNS 指向 Cloudflare 的 anycast IP，而不是源站 IP；Cloudflare 同时维护公开的 IPv4/IPv6 网络段。citeturn664645search1turn664645search5

另外，Cloudflare 代理到源站时会增加 `CF-Ray`、`CF-Connecting-IP` 等请求链路相关信息；`CF-Ray` 也会出现在 Cloudflare 返回给客户端的响应中，因此它可以作为 HTTP 层的辅助信号。citeturn664645search0turn664645search4

# 一、先把问题定义清楚

你的程序实际上应该回答两个问题。

### 问题 A：这个 IP 是不是 Cloudflare Edge IP？

例如：

```text
104.16.77.250
```

只需要判断：

```text
104.16.77.250 ∈ Cloudflare IPv4 ranges
```

这个判断非常可靠。

---

### 问题 B：某个站点是不是通过 Cloudflare CDN 反向代理？

例如：

```text
IP:   104.16.77.250
Host: www.example.com
```

需要进一步检测：

```text
DNS
 ↓
IP 是否属于 Cloudflare
 ↓
HTTP Response
 ↓
CF-Ray
CF-Cache-Status
Server: cloudflare
 ↓
TLS SNI / Certificate
```

所以我建议你的程序最终支持：

```bash
# 只检测 IP
cfprobe 104.16.77.250

# 检测 IP + 域名
cfprobe 104.16.77.250 --host example.com

# 指定 HTTPS
cfprobe 104.16.77.250 --host example.com --scheme https

# 指定 HTTP
cfprobe 104.16.77.250 --host example.com --scheme http

# 输出 JSON
cfprobe 104.16.77.250 --host example.com --json
```

---

# 二、推荐的整体架构

我建议拆成 5 个模块：

```text
                 ┌───────────────────────┐
                 │       CLI Layer       │
                 └───────────┬───────────┘
                             │
                     Detector::detect()
                             │
          ┌──────────────────┼──────────────────┐
          │                  │                  │
          ▼                  ▼                  ▼
 ┌────────────────┐  ┌────────────────┐  ┌───────────────┐
 │ Cloudflare IP  │  │ DNS Resolver   │  │ HTTP Probe    │
 │ Range Detector │  │                │  │               │
 └────────────────┘  └────────────────┘  └───────────────┘
          │                  │                  │
          └──────────────────┼──────────────────┘
                             ▼
                    ┌─────────────────┐
                    │ Scoring Engine  │
                    └────────┬────────┘
                             ▼
                    ┌─────────────────┐
                    │ DetectionResult │
                    └─────────────────┘
```

最终输出：

```json
{
  "ip": "104.16.77.250",
  "cloudflare_ip": true,
  "confidence": 0.99,
  "classification": "cloudflare_edge",
  "signals": {
    "cloudflare_ipv4_range": true,
    "cf_ray": true,
    "server_cloudflare": true,
    "cf_cache_status": true
  }
}
```

---

# 三、检测策略

我建议不要简单使用一个 bool，而使用**证据评分**。

例如：

| 信号 | 权重 |
|---|---:|
| IP 属于 Cloudflare 官方 IP 段 | +80 |
| HTTP 出现 `CF-Ray` | +10 |
| `Server: cloudflare` | +5 |
| `CF-Cache-Status` | +5 |
| Cloudflare 特有响应行为 | +5 |
| DNS 解析结果属于 Cloudflare IP | +20 |
| TLS/HTTP 多项证据一致 | +10 |

最终：

```text
>= 80    Definitely Cloudflare
>= 60    Very Likely
>= 35    Likely
< 35     Unknown
```

不过这里有一个重要原则：

**IP 命中 Cloudflare 官方网段应该单独作为强证据，而不是单纯依赖 HTTP Header。**

因为：

```http
Server: cloudflare
CF-Ray: xxxx
```

理论上都可以被后面的 HTTP 服务器伪造。

但是：

```text
104.16.77.250 ∈ Cloudflare Network
```

可靠得多。

Cloudflare 官方明确说明，代理记录会解析到其 anycast IP 地址，而且这些 IP 网段是 Cloudflare 官方维护的共享网络。citeturn664645search1turn664645search7

```bash
cargo new cfprobe
cd cfprobe
```

```text
cfprobe/
├── Cargo.toml

```

# 五、Cargo.toml

```toml
[package]
name = "cfprobe"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
reqwest = { version = "0.12", default-features = false, features = [
    "rustls-tls",
] }

```

这里使用 `reqwest + rustls`，不需要依赖 OpenSSL。

# 六、核心实现

下面这版可以直接作为第一版 MVP。

`src/main.rs`：

```rust
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use clap::{Parser, ValueEnum};
use reqwest::header::{HeaderMap, HeaderName, HeaderValue, HOST};
use serde::Serialize;
use std::fmt;
use std::net::{IpAddr, SocketAddr};
use std::str::FromStr;
use std::time::Duration;

const CF_IPV4_URL: &str = "https://www.cloudflare.com/ips-v4/";
const CF_IPV6_URL: &str = "https://www.cloudflare.com/ips-v6/";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, ValueEnum)]
enum Scheme {
    Http,
    Https,
}

impl Scheme {
    fn as_str(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Scheme::Http => "http",
            Scheme::Https => "https",
        }
    }

    fn default_port(&self) -> u16 {
        match self {
            Scheme::Http => 80,
            Scheme::Https => 443,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
#[command(
    name = "cfprobe",
    version,
    about = "Detect whether an IP is served by Cloudflare reverse proxy/CDN"
)]
struct Args {
    /// Target IP address
    ip: IpAddr,

    /// Optional HTTP Host / TLS SNI hostname
    #[arg(short, long)]
    host: Option<String>,

    /// HTTP or HTTPS
    #[arg(short, long, value_enum, default_value_t = Scheme::Https)]
    scheme: Scheme,

    /// Connection timeout in seconds
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 8)]
    timeout: u64,

    /// Ignore TLS certificate verification
    #[arg(long)]
    insecure: bool,

    /// Output JSON
    #[arg(long)]
    json: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct Cidr {
    network: IpAddr,
    prefix: u8,
}

impl FromStr for Cidr {
    type Err = anyhow::Error;

    fn from_str(s: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        let (ip, prefix) = s
            .split_once('/')
            .context("invalid CIDR")?;

        let network: IpAddr = ip.parse().context("invalid IP")?;
        let prefix: u8 = prefix.parse().context("invalid prefix")?;

        match network {
            IpAddr::V4(_) if prefix > 32 => {
                anyhow::bail!("IPv4 prefix must be <= 32");
            }
            IpAddr::V6(_) if prefix > 128 => {
                anyhow::bail!("IPv6 prefix must be <= 128");
            }
            _ => {}
        }

        Ok(Self { network, prefix })
    }
}

impl Cidr {
    fn contains(&self, ip: IpAddr) -> bool {
        match (self.network, ip) {
            (IpAddr::V4(network), IpAddr::V4(ip)) => {
                let network = u32::from(network);
                let ip = u32::from(ip);

                if self.prefix == 0 {
                    return true;
                }

                let mask = u32::MAX << (32 - self.prefix);
                (network & mask) == (ip & mask)
            }

            (IpAddr::V6(network), IpAddr::V6(ip)) => {
                let network = u128::from_be_bytes(network.octets());
                let ip = u128::from_be_bytes(ip.octets());

                if self.prefix == 0 {
                    return true;
                }

                let mask = u128::MAX << (128 - self.prefix);
                (network & mask) == (ip & mask)
            }

            _ => false,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct CloudflareRanges {
    ipv4: Vec<Cidr>,
    ipv6: Vec<Cidr>,
}

impl CloudflareRanges {
    async fn load(client: &reqwest::Client) -> Result<Self> {
        let ipv4_body = client
            .get(CF_IPV4_URL)
            .send()
            .await
            .context("failed to fetch Cloudflare IPv4 ranges")?
            .error_for_status()?
            .text()
            .await?;

        let ipv6_body = client
            .get(CF_IPV6_URL)
            .send()
            .await
            .context("failed to fetch Cloudflare IPv6 ranges")?
            .error_for_status()?
            .text()
            .await?;

        let ipv4 = parse_ranges(&ipv4_body)?;
        let ipv6 = parse_ranges(&ipv6_body)?;

        Ok(Self { ipv4, ipv6 })
    }

    fn contains(&self, ip: IpAddr) -> bool {
        match ip {
            IpAddr::V4(_) => self.ipv4.iter().any(|x| x.contains(ip)),
            IpAddr::V6(_) => self.ipv6.iter().any(|x| x.contains(ip)),
        }
    }
}

fn parse_ranges(body: &str) -> Result<Vec<Cidr>> {
    let mut result = Vec::new();

    for line in body.lines() {
        let line = line.trim();

        if line.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }

        result.push(line.parse()?);
    }

    Ok(result)
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct HttpProbeResult {
    attempted: bool,

    status: Option<u16>,

    server: Option<String>,

    cf_ray: Option<String>,

    cf_cache_status: Option<String>,

    headers: Vec<(String, String)>,

    error: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct Signals {
    cloudflare_ip_range: bool,

    cf_ray: bool,

    server_cloudflare: bool,

    cf_cache_status: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct DetectionResult {
    ip: String,

    host: Option<String>,

    scheme: String,

    classification: String,

    confidence: u8,

    cloudflare_ip: bool,

    signals: Signals,

    http: HttpProbeResult,
}

impl fmt::Display for DetectionResult {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        writeln!(f, "Cloudflare Probe")?;
        writeln!(f, "================")?;

        writeln!(f, "IP           : {}", self.ip)?;

        if let Some(host) = &self.host {
            writeln!(f, "Host         : {}", host)?;
        }

        writeln!(f, "Scheme       : {}", self.scheme)?;
        writeln!(f, "Cloudflare IP: {}", self.cloudflare_ip)?;
        writeln!(f, "Classification: {}", self.classification)?;
        writeln!(f, "Confidence   : {}%", self.confidence)?;

        writeln!(f)?;
        writeln!(f, "Signals:")?;

        writeln!(
            f,
            "  Cloudflare IP Range : {}",
            self.signals.cloudflare_ip_range
        )?;

        writeln!(
            f,
            "  CF-Ray              : {}",
            self.signals.cf_ray
        )?;

        writeln!(
            f,
            "  Server: Cloudflare  : {}",
            self.signals.server_cloudflare
        )?;

        writeln!(
            f,
            "  CF-Cache-Status     : {}",
            self.signals.cf_cache_status
        )?;

        if self.http.attempted {
            writeln!(f)?;
            writeln!(f, "HTTP:")?;

            if let Some(status) = self.http.status {
                writeln!(f, "  Status              : {}", status)?;
            }

            if let Some(server) = &self.http.server {
                writeln!(f, "  Server              : {}", server)?;
            }

            if let Some(ray) = &self.http.cf_ray {
                writeln!(f, "  CF-Ray              : {}", ray)?;
            }

            if let Some(cache) = &self.http.cf_cache_status {
                writeln!(f, "  CF-Cache-Status     : {}", cache)?;
            }

            if let Some(error) = &self.http.error {
                writeln!(f, "  Error               : {}", error)?;
            }
        }

        Ok(())
    }
}

async fn http_probe(
    client: &reqwest::Client,
    ip: IpAddr,
    host: Option<&str>,
    scheme: &Scheme,
) -> HttpProbeResult {
    let port = scheme.default_port();

    // 如果没有 Host，就只能直接访问 IP。
    let target_host = host.unwrap_or_else(|| {
        match ip {
            IpAddr::V4(_) => "",
            IpAddr::V6(_) => "",
        }
    });

    let url_host = if host.is_some() {
        host.unwrap().to_string()
    } else {
        match ip {
            IpAddr::V4(_) => ip.to_string(),
            IpAddr::V6(_) => format!("[{}]", ip),
        }
    };

    let url = format!("{}://{}:{}/", scheme.as_str(), url_host, port);

    let mut request = client.get(url);

    if let Some(host) = host {
        if let Ok(value) = HeaderValue::from_str(host) {
            request = request.header(HOST, value);
        }
    } else if !target_host.is_empty() {
        if let Ok(value) = HeaderValue::from_str(target_host) {
            request = request.header(HOST, value);
        }
    }

    match request.send().await {
        Ok(response) => {
            let status = response.status().as_u16();

            let headers = response.headers().clone();

            let server = header_to_string(&headers, "server");
            let cf_ray = header_to_string(&headers, "cf-ray");
            let cf_cache_status = header_to_string(&headers, "cf-cache-status");

            let mut selected_headers = Vec::new();

            for name in [
                "server",
                "cf-ray",
                "cf-cache-status",
                "cf-mitigated",
                "via",
                "age",
                "location",
            ] {
                if let Some(value) = header_to_string(&headers, name) {
                    selected_headers.push((name.to_string(), value));
                }
            }

            HttpProbeResult {
                attempted: true,
                status: Some(status),
                server,
                cf_ray,
                cf_cache_status,
                headers: selected_headers,
                error: None,
            }
        }

        Err(e) => HttpProbeResult {
            attempted: true,
            status: None,
            server: None,
            cf_ray: None,
            cf_cache_status: None,
            headers: Vec::new(),
            error: Some(e.to_string()),
        },
    }
}

fn header_to_string(headers: &HeaderMap, name: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let name = HeaderName::from_bytes(name.as_bytes()).ok()?;

    headers
        .get(name)
        .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok())
        .map(|s| s.to_string())
}

fn calculate_score(
    cloudflare_ip: bool,
    cf_ray: bool,
    server_cloudflare: bool,
    cf_cache_status: bool,
) -> u8 {
    let mut score = 0u16;

    if cloudflare_ip {
        score += 80;
    }

    if cf_ray {
        score += 10;
    }

    if server_cloudflare {
        score += 5;
    }

    if cf_cache_status {
        score += 5;
    }

    score.min(100) as u8
}

fn classification(score: u8, cloudflare_ip: bool) -> String {
    if cloudflare_ip {
        return "cloudflare_edge".to_string();
    }

    match score {
        80..=100 => "very_likely_cloudflare".to_string(),
        60..=79 => "likely_cloudflare".to_string(),
        35..=59 => "possible_cloudflare".to_string(),
        _ => "unknown".to_string(),
    }
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let args = Args::parse();

    let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .user_agent("cfprobe/0.1")
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(args.timeout))
        .danger_accept_invalid_certs(args.insecure)
        .build()?;

    println!("Loading Cloudflare IP ranges...");

    let ranges = CloudflareRanges::load(&client).await?;

    let cloudflare_ip = ranges.contains(args.ip);

    let http_client = if let Some(host) = &args.host {
        let addr = SocketAddr::new(args.ip, args.scheme.default_port());

        reqwest::Client::builder()
            .user_agent("cfprobe/0.1")
            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(args.timeout))
            .danger_accept_invalid_certs(args.insecure)
            .resolve(host, addr)
            .build()?
    } else {
        client.clone()
    };

    let http = if args.host.is_some() {
        http_probe(
            &http_client,
            args.ip,
            args.host.as_deref(),
            &args.scheme,
        )
        .await
    } else {
        HttpProbeResult {
            attempted: false,
            status: None,
            server: None,
            cf_ray: None,
            cf_cache_status: None,
            headers: Vec::new(),
            error: None,
        }
    };

    let cf_ray = http.cf_ray.is_some();

    let server_cloudflare = http
        .server
        .as_deref()
        .map(|value| value.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("cloudflare"))
        .unwrap_or(false);

    let cf_cache_status = http.cf_cache_status.is_some();

    let score = calculate_score(
        cloudflare_ip,
        cf_ray,
        server_cloudflare,
        cf_cache_status,
    );

    let result = DetectionResult {
        ip: args.ip.to_string(),
        host: args.host.clone(),
        scheme: args.scheme.as_str().to_string(),
        classification: classification(score, cloudflare_ip),
        confidence: score,
        cloudflare_ip,
        signals: Signals {
            cloudflare_ip_range: cloudflare_ip,
            cf_ray,
            server_cloudflare,
            cf_cache_status,
        },
        http,
    };

    if args.json {
        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&result)?);
    } else {
        println!();
        println!("{result}");
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

# 七、运行

例如：

```bash
cargo run -- 104.16.77.250
```

输出类似：

```text
Loading Cloudflare IP ranges...

Cloudflare Probe
================
IP           : 104.16.77.250
Scheme       : https
Cloudflare IP: true
Classification: cloudflare_edge
Confidence   : 80%

Signals:
  Cloudflare IP Range : true
  CF-Ray              : false
  Server: Cloudflare  : false
  CF-Cache-Status     : false
```

这里的 `80%` 并不表示“概率只有 80%”。

它实际上代表：

```text
evidence score = 80
```

这是一个很重要的设计区别。

生产程序里，我建议不要把这种分数直接解释为数学概率。

---

# 八、检测具体网站

比如：

```bash
cargo run -- \
    104.16.77.250 \
    --host example.com \
    --scheme https
```

这里有个非常重要的实现细节。

我们不是：

```text
https://104.16.77.250
```

然后：

```text
Host: example.com
```

简单这样做。

因为 HTTPS 会涉及：

```text
TLS SNI
Host
Certificate
```

如果 URL 是：

```text
https://104.16.77.250
```

TLS SNI 很可能就是 IP。

而正确访问 Cloudflare 站点应该类似：

```text
TLS ClientHello
    SNI = example.com

TCP
    Destination = 104.16.77.250:443

HTTP
    Host = example.com
```

所以代码里使用了：

```rust
.resolve(host, addr)
```

达到：

```text
example.com
      │
      │ SNI / Host
      ▼
Cloudflare
      │
      │ TCP 实际连接
      ▼
104.16.77.250
```

这个设计对于你的检测器非常重要。

---

# 九、为什么不能只检测 `Server: cloudflare`

例如：

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: cloudflare
```

很多程序看到这个就直接：

```rust
true
```

这是不严谨的。

因为：

```text
源站 Nginx
   ↓
自定义 Header
   ↓
Server: cloudflare
```

完全可以伪造。

类似：

```http
CF-Ray: 123456-SJC
```

也可以人为设置。

所以：

```text
HTTP Headers
```

只能当作**辅助证据**。

真正第一优先级应该：

```text
IP ∈ Cloudflare 官方 IP ranges
```

Cloudflare 官方文档也明确指出，共享的 proxied hostname 会使用 Cloudflare anycast IP ranges。citeturn664645search1turn664645search7

---

# 十、不过这个版本还有一个很重要的局限

假设：

```text
IP = 104.16.77.250
```

你只能证明：

```text
这是 Cloudflare 网络中的 IP
```

但不能仅凭这个 IP 证明：

```text
某某域名 example.com 一定在这个 IP 上被 Cloudflare 反代
```

原因是 Cloudflare IP 是共享的。

也就是说：

```text
104.16.77.250
       │
       ├── example-a.com
       ├── example-b.com
       ├── example-c.com
       ├── example-d.com
       └── ...
```

一个 Cloudflare Edge IP 可以服务大量域名。

所以如果你的真实目标是：

> 判断“某个 IP + 某个域名”是不是 Cloudflare CDN

那么：

```text
IP + Host
```

才是比较合理的 API。

# 十一、推荐把 API 设计成这样

最终我建议你把程序抽象成：

```rust
pub struct Detector {
    ...
}

pub struct Target {
    pub ip: IpAddr,
    pub host: Option<String>,
    pub scheme: Scheme,
}

pub struct DetectionResult {
    pub classification: Classification,
    pub confidence: u8,
    pub signals: Signals,
    pub http: HttpProbeResult,
}
```

然后：

```rust
let detector = Detector::new().await?;

let result = detector
    .detect(Target {
        ip,
        host,
        scheme,
    })
    .await?;
```

这样以后你就可以做：

```text
CLI
API
Web Dashboard
批量检测器
扫描器
```

全部复用同一套核心库。

---

# 十二、第二阶段：加入 DNS 检测

这是我非常推荐你增加的一项。

假如：

```text
example.com
```

解析：

```text
104.16.77.250
104.16.76.250
```

程序可以检查：

```text
example.com
    ↓
A / AAAA
    ↓
Cloudflare IP?
```

如果都是：

```text
Cloudflare IP
```

那么：

```text
DNS signal = strong
```

Cloudflare 官方也明确说明，开启 Proxy 的 DNS 记录会返回 Cloudflare anycast 地址，而 DNS-only 则返回源站地址。citeturn664645search5

---

# 十三、第三阶段：加入 TLS 检测

可以进一步获取：

```text
TLS
├── SNI
├── Certificate
├── SAN
├── Issuer
├── Subject
├── ALPN
├── TLS version
└── Cipher
```

例如：

```text
TLS
 ├── SNI = example.com
 ├── ALPN = h2,http/1.1
 └── Certificate
        └── SAN = *.example.com
```

但是这里要注意：

**不能把 Cloudflare TLS 证书作为绝对判断依据。**

因为：

```text
Cloudflare CDN
```

本身就是替客户提供 TLS termination。

而且用户也可能自己部署：

```text
Let's Encrypt
Nginx
Caddy
Cloudflare
```

证书本身不是充分条件。

---

# 十四、第四阶段：加入 ASN / BGP

你的程序做到专业版本时，我建议增加：

```text
IP
 ↓
ASN
 ↓
Organization
```

例如：

```text
AS13335
Cloudflare, Inc.
```

这样会得到另一个强信号：

```text
ASN = Cloudflare
```

但是这里不要把：

```text
ASN = Cloudflare
```

直接等价于：

```text
Cloudflare CDN
```

因为 Cloudflare 有多个产品，不是所有 Cloudflare 网络地址都意味着传统 Web CDN。

官方也明确提到 Cloudflare 存在用于不同产品和服务的其他 IP ranges，而且这些地址不一定会连接到源站。citeturn664645search1

---

# 十五、最终评分模型

我会把最终版本做成：

```text
                Detection Engine
                       │
          ┌────────────┼────────────┐
          │            │            │
          ▼            ▼            ▼
       Network        HTTP         TLS
          │            │            │
          │            │            │
      CF Range       CF-Ray       Certificate
      ASN             Server       SNI
      Reverse DNS    Cache        ALPN
      DNS             Header
          │            │            │
          └────────────┼────────────┘
                       ▼
                 Evidence Engine
                       │
                       ▼
                Classification
```

例如：

```rust
enum Classification {
    CloudflareEdge,
    VeryLikelyCloudflare,
    LikelyCloudflare,
    PossibleCloudflare,
    NotCloudflare,
    Unknown,
}
```

# 十六、建议的生产级评分

我会改成：

```text
Cloudflare IP Range         +80
Cloudflare ASN              +15
DNS -> Cloudflare IP        +20
CF-Ray                      +15
CF-Cache-Status             +10
Server: cloudflare           +5
TLS evidence                 +5
Reverse DNS                  +2
```

然后增加**负证据**：

```text
IP not Cloudflare range     -30
ASN not Cloudflare          -10
```

但不要简单：

```text
分数 > 50 = Cloudflare
```

最好使用规则：

```text
IP Range = true
    ↓
Cloudflare Edge

IP Range = false
AND
ASN = Cloudflare
AND
HTTP CF-Ray
    ↓
Very Likely Cloudflare

只有 HTTP Header
    ↓
Possible / Weak Evidence

没有任何信号
    ↓
Unknown
```

# 十七、最值得增加的功能：Origin Leak Detection

如果你的最终目的是：

> 找出某个网站是不是 Cloudflare CDN，以及 Cloudflare 后面的真实源站 IP

那么就不能停留在这个检测器。

可以进一步增加：

```text
Cloudflare Detection
        ↓
Origin Discovery
        ↓
├── DNS History
├── MX
├── SPF
├── CNAME
├── Subdomain
├── Historical DNS
├── Certificate Transparency
├── Passive DNS
└── Direct-Origin Validation
```

例如：

```text
example.com
       │
       ▼
Cloudflare
104.16.x.x
       │
       │
       ├── mail.example.com
       ├── origin.example.com
       ├── dev.example.com
       ├── old.example.com
       └── api.example.com
```

然后测试：

```text
Candidate Origin IP
       ↓
TLS SNI = example.com
       ↓
HTTP Host = example.com
       ↓
Response fingerprint
       ↓
是否绕过 Cloudflare
```

这样就从一个：

```text
Cloudflare IP Detector
```

升级成：

```text
Cloudflare / CDN Detection Engine
```

不过需要注意，这已经属于更广泛的资产探测范畴，我建议你的实现首先限定为**你自己管理的站点、授权测试目标或公开资产检测**。

```bash
...
```

不需要每次重新下载。

你的程序不要叫：

或者：

然后把能力设计成：

```bash
    --host example.com \

    --host example.com \
    --scheme https \
```

```json
{
```

# 4. error.rs

创建：

```text
src/error.rs
```

内容：

```rust
use std::fmt;

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum CfProbeError {
    Http(reqwest::Error),
    InvalidResponse(String),
    InvalidCidr {
        value: String,
        reason: String,
    },
}

impl fmt::Display for CfProbeError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Http(err) => write!(f, "HTTP request failed: {err}"),

            Self::InvalidResponse(message) => {
                write!(f, "invalid Cloudflare API response: {message}")
            }

            Self::InvalidCidr { value, reason } => {
                write!(f, "invalid CIDR `{value}`: {reason}")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for CfProbeError {}

impl From<reqwest::Error> for CfProbeError {
    fn from(value: reqwest::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Http(value)
    }
}
```

我们这里没有使用 `anyhow` 作为 library 对外错误。

这是非常重要的工程实践：

```text
anyhow
    ↓
适合 application

thiserror / 自定义 Error
    ↓
适合 library
```

以后别人可以：

```rust
match error {
    CfProbeError::Http(_) => ...
    CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(_) => ...
}
```

而不是只能：

```rust
println!("{:?}", error);
```

# 6. ranges.rs

这是第一阶段最核心的代码。

```rust
use ipnet::IpNet;
use std::net::IpAddr;

use crate::error::CfProbeError;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CloudflareRanges {
    ipv4: Vec<IpNet>,
    ipv6: Vec<IpNet>,

    etag: Option<String>,
}

impl CloudflareRanges {
    pub fn new(
        ipv4: Vec<String>,
        ipv6: Vec<String>,
        etag: Option<String>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        let ipv4 = parse_ranges(ipv4)?;
        let ipv6 = parse_ranges(ipv6)?;

        Ok(Self {
            ipv4,
            ipv6,
            etag,
        })
    }

    pub fn contains(&self, ip: IpAddr) -> bool {
        match ip {
            IpAddr::V4(_) => self.ipv4.iter().any(|network| network.contains(&ip)),
            IpAddr::V6(_) => self.ipv6.iter().any(|network| network.contains(&ip)),
        }
    }

    pub fn etag(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        self.etag.as_deref()
    }

    pub fn ipv4_ranges(&self) -> &[IpNet] {
        &self.ipv4
    }

    pub fn ipv6_ranges(&self) -> &[IpNet] {
        &self.ipv6
    }
}

fn parse_ranges(values: Vec<String>) -> Result<Vec<IpNet>, CfProbeError> {
    values
        .into_iter()
        .map(|value| {
            value.parse::<IpNet>().map_err(|error| {
                CfProbeError::InvalidCidr {
                    value,
                    reason: error.to_string(),
                }
            })
        })
        .collect()
}
```

这里我们不自己实现：

```text
IPv4 mask
IPv6 mask
bit shift
```

而是使用 `ipnet`。

这是商业代码一个很重要的取舍：

> **标准网络算法尽可能交给成熟库。**

例如以前我们自己写：

```rust
u32::MAX << (32 - prefix)
```

看起来没问题，但 IPv6、边界 prefix、不同地址族以后都会产生维护成本。

# 7. Cloudflare API Response

创建：

```text
src/cloudflare/client.rs
```

```rust
use reqwest::Client;
use serde::Deserialize;

use crate::error::CfProbeError;

const CLOUDFLARE_IPS_API: &str =
    "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/ips";

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct ApiResponse {
    success: bool,

    #[serde(default)]
    errors: Vec<ApiError>,

    result: Option<ApiResult>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct ApiError {
    code: Option<i64>,
    message: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct ApiResult {
    etag: Option<String>,

    #[serde(default)]
    ipv4_cidrs: Vec<String>,

    #[serde(default)]
    ipv6_cidrs: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct CloudflareClient {
    client: Client,
    endpoint: String,
}

impl CloudflareClient {
    pub fn new(client: Client) -> Self {
        Self {
            client,
            endpoint: CLOUDFLARE_IPS_API.to_string(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_endpoint(
        client: Client,
        endpoint: impl Into<String>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            client,
            endpoint: endpoint.into(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn fetch_ranges(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<CloudflareApiRanges, CfProbeError> {
        let response = self
            .client
            .get(&self.endpoint)
            .send()
            .await?;

        let status = response.status();

        if !status.is_success() {
            return Err(CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(format!(
                "Cloudflare returned HTTP status {}",
                status
            )));
        }

        let response: ApiResponse = response
            .json()
            .await?;

        if !response.success {
            let message = response
                .errors
                .into_iter()
                .map(|error| {
                    match (error.code, error.message) {
                        (Some(code), Some(message)) => {
                            format!("[{code}] {message}")
                        }

                        (_, Some(message)) => message,

                        (Some(code), None) => {
                            format!("error code {code}")
                        }

                        _ => "unknown Cloudflare API error".to_string(),
                    }
                })
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join("; ");

            return Err(CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(message));
        }

        let result = response
            .result
            .ok_or_else(|| {
                CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                    "missing `result` field".to_string(),
                )
            })?;

        Ok(CloudflareApiRanges {
            etag: result.etag,
            ipv4_cidrs: result.ipv4_cidrs,
            ipv6_cidrs: result.ipv6_cidrs,
        })
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CloudflareApiRanges {
    pub etag: Option<String>,
    pub ipv4_cidrs: Vec<String>,
    pub ipv6_cidrs: Vec<String>,
}
```

Cloudflare 官方 `/ips` API 的响应确实包含：

```json
{
  "result": {
    "etag": "...",
    "ipv4_cidrs": [],
    "ipv6_cidrs": []
  }
}
```

所以我们直接围绕官方响应模型设计。citeturn761165search3

再创建：

```text
src/cloudflare/provider.rs
```

```rust
use std::net::IpAddr;

use crate::cloudflare::{
    CloudflareClient,
    CloudflareRanges,
};
use crate::error::CfProbeError;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct CloudflareRangeProvider {
    client: CloudflareClient,
}

impl CloudflareRangeProvider {
    pub fn new(client: CloudflareClient) -> Self {
        Self { client }
    }

    pub async fn load(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<CloudflareRanges, CfProbeError> {
        let remote = self.client.fetch_ranges().await?;

        CloudflareRanges::new(
            remote.ipv4_cidrs,
            remote.ipv6_cidrs,
            remote.etag,
        )
    }

    pub async fn contains(
        &self,
        ip: IpAddr,
    ) -> Result<bool, CfProbeError> {
        let ranges = self.load().await?;

        Ok(ranges.contains(ip))
    }
}
```

这层目前看起来好像有点“多余”。

实际上它是故意存在的。

以后：

```text
CloudflareRangeProvider
```

会负责：

```text
远程数据
↓
缓存
↓
更新
↓
版本
↓
失效
```

而：

```text
CloudflareRanges
```

永远只负责：

```text
数据
↓
判断
```

这就是良好的职责隔离。

```rust
use std::net::IpAddr;

use serde::Serialize;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
pub enum DetectionKind {
    CloudflareEdge,
    NotCloudflare,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct CloudflareIpDetection {
    pub ip: IpAddr,
    pub is_cloudflare: bool,
    pub kind: DetectionKind,
}

impl CloudflareIpDetection {
    pub fn cloudflare(ip: IpAddr) -> Self {
        Self {
            ip,
            is_cloudflare: true,
            kind: DetectionKind::CloudflareEdge,
        }
    }

    pub fn not_cloudflare(ip: IpAddr) -> Self {
        Self {
            ip,
            is_cloudflare: false,
            kind: DetectionKind::NotCloudflare,
        }
    }
}
```

# 11. 给 detector 增加真正的核心逻辑

```text

```

内容：

```rust
use std::net::IpAddr;

use crate::{
    CloudflareIpDetection,
    CloudflareRanges,
};

pub fn detect_cloudflare_ip(
    ranges: &CloudflareRanges,
    ip: IpAddr,
) -> CloudflareIpDetection {
    if ranges.contains(ip) {
        CloudflareIpDetection::cloudflare(ip)
    } else {
        CloudflareIpDetection::not_cloudflare(ip)
    }
}
```

# 12. 写测试

商业项目里，这一步非常重要。

创建：

```text
tests/cloudflare_ranges.rs
```

```rust
use std::net::{IpAddr, Ipv4Addr, Ipv6Addr};

use cfprobe::{
    CloudflareRanges,
    DetectionKind,
    detect_cloudflare_ip,
};

#[test]
fn detect_cloudflare_ipv4() {
    let ranges = CloudflareRanges::new(
        vec![
            "104.16.0.0/13".to_string(),
        ],
        vec![],
        Some("test-etag".to_string()),
    )
    .unwrap();

    let ip = IpAddr::V4(
        Ipv4Addr::new(104, 16, 1, 1)
    );

    let result = detect_cloudflare_ip(&ranges, ip);

    assert!(result.is_cloudflare);
    assert_eq!(
        result.kind,
        DetectionKind::CloudflareEdge
    );
}

#[test]
fn detect_non_cloudflare_ipv4() {
    let ranges = CloudflareRanges::new(
        vec![
            "104.16.0.0/13".to_string(),
        ],
        vec![],
        None,
    )
    .unwrap();

    let ip = IpAddr::V4(
        Ipv4Addr::new(8, 8, 8, 8)
    );

    let result = detect_cloudflare_ip(&ranges, ip);

    assert!(!result.is_cloudflare);
    assert_eq!(
        result.kind,
        DetectionKind::NotCloudflare
    );
}

#[test]
fn detect_cloudflare_ipv6() {
    let ranges = CloudflareRanges::new(
        vec![],
        vec![
            "2400:cb00::/32".to_string(),
        ],
        None,
    )
    .unwrap();

    let ip = IpAddr::V6(
        "2400:cb00:1234::1"
            .parse()
            .unwrap()
    );

    let result = detect_cloudflare_ip(&ranges, ip);

    assert!(result.is_cloudflare);
}

#[test]
fn reject_invalid_cidr() {
    let result = CloudflareRanges::new(
        vec![
            "invalid".to_string(),
        ],
        vec![],
        None,
    );

    assert!(result.is_err());
}
```

# 16. 这里有一个很重要的设计决定

你可能会发现现在：

```rust
provider.load().await?
```

每调用一次：

```text
HTTP GET Cloudflare API
```

这在正式产品里绝对不行。

所以接下来我们不会马上写 HTTP detector。

而是先解决：

# Phase 2：可靠缓存系统

最终应该变成：

```text
                   ┌───────────────┐
                   │ Cloudflare API│
                   └───────┬───────┘
                           │
                     ETag / Update
                           │
                           ▼
              ┌────────────────────────┐
              │ CloudflareRangeProvider│
              └────────────┬───────────┘
                           │
                ┌──────────┴──────────┐
                │                     │
           Memory Cache           Disk Cache
                │                     │
                └──────────┬──────────┘
                           │
                           ▼
                   CloudflareRanges
```

并且利用 Cloudflare `/ips` API 自带的 `etag`。官方文档明确说明 `etag` 是 IP 数据摘要，可以用来判断数据是否发生变化。citeturn761165search0turn761165search3

这样：

```text
第一次启动
    ↓
下载

第二次启动
    ↓
读取本地缓存

24小时以后
    ↓
If-None-Match / ETag
    ↓
数据没变化
    ↓
不重新下载

数据变化
    ↓
更新缓存
```

这才是商用软件应该有的行为。

## 下一步：Phase 2

下一步我们就实现 **Cloudflare IP Range Cache**，包括：

```text
Memory Cache
      +
Disk Cache
      +
ETag
      +
Atomic File Replace
      +
文件损坏自动恢复
      +
TTL
      +
并发初始化防止重复下载
```

尤其是“**多个线程/多个请求同时发现缓存过期，只允许一个线程刷新 Cloudflare IP 数据**”这个问题，我们会从一开始就设计好，否则以后做高并发 API 时很容易踩坑。

这一步完成后，`cfprobe` 的 Cloudflare IP 判断核心就真正具备商用基础了。

可以。Phase 2 我们现在正式把 **Cloudflare IP Range Provider** 升级成一个适合长期运行的缓存组件。

这一阶段的目标不是单纯“把文件写到磁盘”，而是把下面这些问题一起解决：

```text
                   Cloudflare API
                         │
                         ▼
                  ETag Conditional GET
                         │
             ┌───────────┴───────────┐
             │                       │
        HTTP 200                  HTTP 304
             │                       │
             ▼                       ▼
        新数据                   保留旧数据
             │                       │
             └───────────┬───────────┘
                         ▼
                    Atomic Write
                         │
                         ▼
                    Disk Cache
                         │
              ┌──────────┴──────────┐
              │                     │
       Process Memory         Other Processes
              │                     │
           RwLock               File Lock
              │                     │
              └──────────┬──────────┘
                         ▼
                     Detector
```

这里使用 `If-None-Match` 做条件请求；Reqwest 当前提供对应的 `IF_NONE_MATCH` header 常量。`304 Not Modified` 时不需要重新下载资源。citeturn313048search1

文件锁采用 `fs2 0.4.3`，它在 Unix 上使用 `flock`，Windows 使用对应的锁机制，而且提供 `try_lock_exclusive()`。citeturn664931view0turn476935search1

磁盘写入采用 `atomic-write-file`，当前文档版本为 0.3.1，它通过临时文件 + commit 的方式保证目标文件在提交前仍保持旧内容。citeturn713923view0

# 2. 扩展 error.rs

现在的 `src/error.rs` 太简单了。

直接替换：

```rust
use std::fmt;
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum CfProbeError {
    Http(reqwest::Error),

    Io(std::io::Error),

    Json(serde_json::Error),

    InvalidResponse(String),

    InvalidCidr {
        value: String,
        reason: String,
    },

    CacheCorrupted {
        path: PathBuf,
        reason: String,
    },

    CacheLockTimeout,

    CacheDirectoryUnavailable,

    SystemClock(std::time::SystemTimeError),
}

impl fmt::Display for CfProbeError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Http(err) => {
                write!(f, "HTTP request failed: {err}")
            }

            Self::Io(err) => {
                write!(f, "I/O error: {err}")
            }

            Self::Json(err) => {
                write!(f, "JSON error: {err}")
            }

            Self::InvalidResponse(message) => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "invalid Cloudflare API response: {message}"
                )
            }

            Self::InvalidCidr { value, reason } => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "invalid CIDR `{value}`: {reason}"
                )
            }

            Self::CacheCorrupted { path, reason } => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "cache file `{}` is corrupted: {reason}",
                    path.display()
                )
            }

            Self::CacheLockTimeout => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "timed out waiting for Cloudflare cache lock"
                )
            }

            Self::CacheDirectoryUnavailable => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "unable to determine a platform cache directory"
                )
            }

            Self::SystemClock(err) => {
                write!(f, "system clock error: {err}")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for CfProbeError {}

impl From<reqwest::Error> for CfProbeError {
    fn from(value: reqwest::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Http(value)
    }
}

impl From<std::io::Error> for CfProbeError {
    fn from(value: std::io::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Io(value)
    }
}

impl From<serde_json::Error> for CfProbeError {
    fn from(value: serde_json::Error) -> Self {
        Self::Json(value)
    }
}

impl From<std::time::SystemTimeError> for CfProbeError {
    fn from(value: std::time::SystemTimeError) -> Self {
        Self::SystemClock(value)
    }
}
```

# 3. 修改 Cloudflare Client

现在的 `client.rs` 需要增加：

```text
正常请求
304 判断
ETag
```

完整替换：

```rust
use reqwest::header::{
    HeaderValue,
    ETAG,
    IF_NONE_MATCH,
};
use reqwest::Client;
use serde::Deserialize;

use crate::error::CfProbeError;

const CLOUDFLARE_IPS_API: &str =
    "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/ips";

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct ApiResponse {
    success: bool,

    #[serde(default)]
    errors: Vec<ApiError>,

    result: Option<ApiResult>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct ApiError {
    code: Option<i64>,

    message: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct ApiResult {
    etag: Option<String>,

    #[serde(default)]
    ipv4_cidrs: Vec<String>,

    #[serde(default)]
    ipv6_cidrs: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct CloudflareClient {
    client: Client,

    endpoint: String,
}

impl CloudflareClient {
    pub fn new(client: Client) -> Self {
        Self {
            client,
            endpoint: CLOUDFLARE_IPS_API.to_string(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_endpoint(
        client: Client,
        endpoint: impl Into<String>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            client,
            endpoint: endpoint.into(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn fetch_ranges(
        &self,
        etag: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<CloudflareFetchResult, CfProbeError> {
        let mut request = self
            .client
            .get(&self.endpoint);

        if let Some(etag) = etag {
            let value = HeaderValue::from_str(etag)
                .map_err(|error| {
                    CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                        format!(
                            "invalid cached ETag: {error}"
                        )
                    )
                })?;

            request = request.header(IF_NONE_MATCH, value);
        }

        let response = request.send().await?;

        if response.status()
            == reqwest::StatusCode::NOT_MODIFIED
        {
            return Ok(
                CloudflareFetchResult::NotModified
            );
        }

        let status = response.status();

        if !status.is_success() {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                    format!(
                        "Cloudflare returned HTTP status {}",
                        status
                    ),
                ),
            );
        }

        // 有些服务会把 ETag 放在 HTTP header，
        // 我们保留它作为 result.etag 的 fallback。
        let header_etag = response
            .headers()
            .get(ETAG)
            .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok())
            .map(ToOwned::to_owned);

        let response: ApiResponse =
            response.json().await?;

        if !response.success {
            let message = response
                .errors
                .into_iter()
                .map(|error| {
                    match (
                        error.code,
                        error.message,
                    ) {
                        (
                            Some(code),
                            Some(message),
                        ) => {
                            format!(
                                "[{code}] {message}"
                            )
                        }

                        (_, Some(message)) => {
                            message
                        }

                        (Some(code), None) => {
                            format!(
                                "error code {code}"
                            )
                        }

                        _ => {
                            "unknown Cloudflare API error"
                                .to_string()
                        }
                    }
                })
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join("; ");

            return Err(
                CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                    message,
                ),
            );
        }

        let result = response
            .result
            .ok_or_else(|| {
                CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                    "missing `result` field"
                        .to_string(),
                )
            })?;

        let etag =
            result.etag.or(header_etag);

        if result.ipv4_cidrs.is_empty()
            && result.ipv6_cidrs.is_empty()
        {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                    "Cloudflare returned an empty IP range set"
                        .to_string(),
                ),
            );
        }

        Ok(
            CloudflareFetchResult::Updated(
                CloudflareApiRanges {
                    etag,
                    ipv4_cidrs:
                        result.ipv4_cidrs,
                    ipv6_cidrs:
                        result.ipv6_cidrs,
                },
            ),
        )
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum CloudflareFetchResult {
    NotModified,

    Updated(CloudflareApiRanges),
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CloudflareApiRanges {
    pub etag: Option<String>,

    pub ipv4_cidrs: Vec<String>,

    pub ipv6_cidrs: Vec<String>,
}
```

完整代码：

```rust
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{
    Duration,
    SystemTime,
    UNIX_EPOCH,
};

use atomic_write_file::AtomicWriteFile;
use directories::ProjectDirs;
use fs2::FileExt;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use tokio::sync::{
    Mutex,
    RwLock,
};

use crate::cloudflare::{
    CloudflareClient,
    CloudflareRanges,
};
use crate::error::CfProbeError;

const CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION: u32 = 1;

const CACHE_FILE_NAME: &str =
    "cloudflare-ip-ranges.json";

const LOCK_FILE_NAME: &str =
    "cloudflare-ip-ranges.lock";

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CacheConfig {
    /// 多久认为缓存是 fresh。
    pub refresh_interval: Duration,

    /// 网络失败时最多允许使用多久以前的数据。
    pub stale_if_error: Duration,

    /// 等待其他进程刷新缓存的最长时间。
    pub lock_timeout: Duration,

    /// 轮询文件锁的间隔。
    pub lock_retry_interval: Duration,
}

impl Default for CacheConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            refresh_interval:
                Duration::from_secs(
                    24 * 60 * 60,
                ),

            stale_if_error:
                Duration::from_secs(
                    7 * 24 * 60 * 60,
                ),

            lock_timeout:
                Duration::from_secs(30),

            lock_retry_interval:
                Duration::from_millis(100),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum CacheSource {
    Memory,
    Disk,
    Network,
    NotModified,
    StaleFallback,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct CacheResult {
    pub ranges: Arc<CloudflareRanges>,

    pub source: CacheSource,

    pub fetched_at: SystemTime,

    pub etag: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct CacheFile {
    schema_version: u32,

    fetched_at_unix: i64,

    etag: Option<String>,

    ipv4_cidrs: Vec<String>,

    ipv6_cidrs: Vec<String>,
}

impl CacheFile {
    fn age(&self) -> Option<Duration> {
        let fetched_at =
            UNIX_EPOCH
                .checked_add(
                    Duration::from_secs(
                        self.fetched_at_unix
                            .try_into()
                            .ok()?,
                    ),
                )?;

        SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(fetched_at)
            .ok()
    }

    fn fetched_at(&self) -> Option<SystemTime> {
        let seconds: u64 =
            self.fetched_at_unix.try_into().ok()?;

        UNIX_EPOCH.checked_add(
            Duration::from_secs(seconds),
        )
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct CloudflareRangeCache {
    client: CloudflareClient,

    cache_file: PathBuf,

    lock_file: PathBuf,

    config: CacheConfig,

    memory: Arc<
        RwLock<Option<Arc<MemoryEntry>>>,
    >,

    refresh_lock: Arc<Mutex<()>>,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct MemoryEntry {
    ranges: Arc<CloudflareRanges>,

    fetched_at: SystemTime,

    etag: Option<String>,
}

impl CloudflareRangeCache {
    pub fn new(
        client: CloudflareClient,
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        let project_dirs =
            ProjectDirs::from(
                "com",
                "cfprobe",
                "cfprobe",
            )
            .ok_or(
                CfProbeError::CacheDirectoryUnavailable
            )?;

        let cache_dir =
            project_dirs.cache_dir();

        Self::with_cache_dir(
            client,
            cache_dir,
        )
    }

    pub fn with_cache_dir(
        client: CloudflareClient,
        cache_dir: impl AsRef<Path>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        let cache_dir =
            cache_dir.as_ref();

        let cache_file =
            cache_dir.join(
                CACHE_FILE_NAME
            );

        let lock_file =
            cache_dir.join(
                LOCK_FILE_NAME
            );

        Ok(Self {
            client,

            cache_file,

            lock_file,

            config:
                CacheConfig::default(),

            memory: Arc::new(
                RwLock::new(None)
            ),

            refresh_lock: Arc::new(
                Mutex::new(())
            ),
        })
    }

    pub fn with_config(
        mut self,
        config: CacheConfig,
    ) -> Self {
        self.config = config;

        self
    }

    pub fn cache_file(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.cache_file
    }

    pub async fn get(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<CacheResult, CfProbeError> {
        // -------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Memory cache
        // -------------------------------------------------

        if let Some(entry) =
            self.memory_read_fresh().await
        {
            return Ok(CacheResult {
                ranges: entry.ranges.clone(),

                source:
                    CacheSource::Memory,

                fetched_at:
                    entry.fetched_at,

                etag:
                    entry.etag.clone(),
            });
        }

        // -------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Process-local refresh lock
        // -------------------------------------------------

        let _refresh_guard =
            self.refresh_lock.lock().await;

        // 双重检查。
        //
        // 在我们等待 Mutex 的时候，
        // 另一个 task 可能已经完成刷新。
        if let Some(entry) =
            self.memory_read_fresh().await
        {
            return Ok(CacheResult {
                ranges: entry.ranges.clone(),

                source:
                    CacheSource::Memory,

                fetched_at:
                    entry.fetched_at,

                etag:
                    entry.etag.clone(),
            });
        }

        // -------------------------------------------------
        // 3. Disk cache
        // -------------------------------------------------

        if let Some(cache) =
            self.read_disk_cache().await?
        {
            if self.is_fresh(&cache) {
                let result =
                    self.install_memory(
                        cache,
                        CacheSource::Disk,
                    )
                    .await?;

                return Ok(result);
            }
        }

        // -------------------------------------------------
        // 4. Cross-process file lock
        // -------------------------------------------------

        let lock = self
            .acquire_process_lock()
            .await?;

        // 非常重要：
        //
        // 进程 A 获取 Mutex 后，
        // 进程 B 可能已经在我们之前更新了 cache。
        //
        // 所以获取 file lock 后必须再次检查 disk。
        if let Some(cache) =
            self.read_disk_cache().await?
        {
            if self.is_fresh(&cache) {
                let result =
                    self.install_memory(
                        cache,
                        CacheSource::Disk,
                    )
                    .await?;

                drop(lock);

                return Ok(result);
            }
        }

        // -------------------------------------------------
        // 5. Stale cache
        // -------------------------------------------------

        let stale_cache =
            self.read_disk_cache().await?;

        let stale_result =
            match stale_cache {
                Some(cache)
                    if self.is_stale_usable(
                        &cache,
                    ) =>
                {
                    Some(cache)
                }

                _ => None,
            };

        // -------------------------------------------------
        // 6. Conditional HTTP request
        // -------------------------------------------------

        let etag = stale_result
            .as_ref()
            .and_then(|cache| {
                cache.etag.as_deref()
            });

        let fetch_result =
            self.client
                .fetch_ranges(etag)
                .await;

        match fetch_result {
            Ok(
                crate::cloudflare::client::
                    CloudflareFetchResult::NotModified,
            ) => {
                let stale =
                    stale_result.ok_or_else(
                        || {
                            CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                                "Cloudflare returned 304 but local cache is unavailable"
                                    .to_string(),
                            )
                        }
                    )?;

                let now =
                    current_unix_timestamp()?;

                let updated_cache =
                    CacheFile {
                        schema_version:
                            CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION,

                        fetched_at_unix:
                            now,

                        etag:
                            stale.etag.clone(),

                        ipv4_cidrs:
                            stale.ipv4_cidrs
                                .clone(),

                        ipv6_cidrs:
                            stale.ipv6_cidrs
                                .clone(),
                    };

                // 即使 304，也更新 fetched_at。
                //
                // 否则如果 API 长期都是 304，
                // 本地缓存仍会因为旧 timestamp 被
                // 判断为 stale。
                let _ =
                    self.write_disk_cache(
                        &updated_cache,
                    )
                    .await;

                let result =
                    self.install_memory_from_cache(
                        &updated_cache,
                        CacheSource::NotModified,
                    )
                    .await?;

                drop(lock);

                Ok(result)
            }

            Ok(
                crate::cloudflare::client::
                    CloudflareFetchResult::Updated(
                        remote,
                    ),
            ) => {
                let now =
                    current_unix_timestamp()?;

                let cache =
                    CacheFile {
                        schema_version:
                            CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION,

                        fetched_at_unix:
                            now,

                        etag:
                            remote.etag.clone(),

                        ipv4_cidrs:
                            remote.ipv4_cidrs
                                .clone(),

                        ipv6_cidrs:
                            remote.ipv6_cidrs
                                .clone(),
                    };

                // 远程数据已经成功拿到。
                //
                // 即使磁盘写入失败，
                // 也应该继续使用内存中的新数据，
                // 而不是让整个检测失败。
                let ranges =
                    Arc::new(
                        CloudflareRanges::new(
                            remote.ipv4_cidrs
                                .clone(),

                            remote.ipv6_cidrs
                                .clone(),

                            remote.etag.clone(),
                        )?
                    );

                let memory =
                    MemoryEntry {
                        ranges:
                            ranges.clone(),

                        fetched_at:
                            UNIX_EPOCH.checked_add(
                                Duration::from_secs(
                                    now.try_into()
                                        .map_err(
                                            |_| {
                                                CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                                                    "timestamp overflow"
                                                        .to_string(),
                                                )
                                            }
                                        )?,
                                )
                            )
                            .ok_or_else(
                                || {
                                    CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                                        "invalid timestamp"
                                            .to_string(),
                                    )
                                }
                            )?,

                        etag:
                            remote.etag.clone(),
                    };

                {
                    let mut guard =
                        self.memory.write().await;

                    *guard =
                        Some(Arc::new(
                            memory
                        ));
                }

                let _ =
                    self.write_disk_cache(
                        &cache,
                    )
                    .await;

                drop(lock);

                Ok(CacheResult {
                    ranges,

                    source:
                        CacheSource::Network,

                    fetched_at:
                        SystemTime::now(),

                    etag:
                        remote.etag,
                })
            }

            Err(error) => {
                // 网络失败，但是 stale cache 仍然可用。
                if let Some(cache) =
                    stale_result
                {
                    let result =
                        self.install_memory_from_cache(
                            &cache,
                            CacheSource::StaleFallback,
                        )
                        .await?;

                    drop(lock);

                    return Ok(result);
                }

                drop(lock);

                Err(error)
            }
        }
    }

    async fn memory_read_fresh(
        &self,
    ) -> Option<Arc<MemoryEntry>> {
        let guard =
            self.memory.read().await;

        let entry = guard.as_ref()?;

        let age =
            entry.fetched_at
                .elapsed()
                .ok()?;

        if age <= self.config.refresh_interval {
            Some(entry.clone())
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    fn is_fresh(
        &self,
        cache: &CacheFile,
    ) -> bool {
        cache
            .age()
            .map(|age| {
                age <= self.config.refresh_interval
            })
            .unwrap_or(false)
    }

    fn is_stale_usable(
        &self,
        cache: &CacheFile,
    ) -> bool {
        cache
            .age()
            .map(|age| {
                age <= self.config.stale_if_error
            })
            .unwrap_or(false)
    }

    async fn install_memory(
        &self,
        cache: CacheFile,
        source: CacheSource,
    ) -> Result<CacheResult, CfProbeError> {
        self.install_memory_from_cache(
            &cache,
            source,
        )
        .await
    }

    async fn install_memory_from_cache(
        &self,
        cache: &CacheFile,
        source: CacheSource,
    ) -> Result<CacheResult, CfProbeError> {
        if cache.schema_version
            != CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION
        {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::CacheCorrupted {
                    path:
                        self.cache_file.clone(),

                    reason:
                        format!(
                            "unsupported schema version {}",
                            cache.schema_version
                        ),
                }
            );
        }

        let ranges =
            Arc::new(
                CloudflareRanges::new(
                    cache.ipv4_cidrs
                        .clone(),

                    cache.ipv6_cidrs
                        .clone(),

                    cache.etag.clone(),
                )?
            );

        let fetched_at =
            cache
                .fetched_at()
                .ok_or_else(
                    || {
                        CfProbeError::CacheCorrupted {
                            path:
                                self.cache_file
                                    .clone(),

                            reason:
                                "invalid timestamp"
                                    .to_string(),
                        }
                    }
                )?;

        let entry =
            MemoryEntry {
                ranges:
                    ranges.clone(),

                fetched_at,

                etag:
                    cache.etag.clone(),
            };

        {
            let mut guard =
                self.memory.write().await;

            *guard =
                Some(
                    Arc::new(entry)
                );
        }

        Ok(CacheResult {
            ranges,

            source,

            fetched_at,

            etag:
                cache.etag.clone(),
        })
    }

    async fn read_disk_cache(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<Option<CacheFile>, CfProbeError> {
        let bytes =
            match tokio::fs::read(
                &self.cache_file
            )
            .await
            {
                Ok(bytes) => bytes,

                Err(error)
                    if error.kind()
                        == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound =>
                {
                    return Ok(None);
                }

                Err(error) => {
                    return Err(
                        error.into()
                    );
                }
            };

        let cache: CacheFile =
            match serde_json::from_slice(
                &bytes
            ) {
                Ok(cache) => cache,

                Err(error) => {
                    // 缓存损坏不能直接 panic。
                    //
                    // 删除后下次重新获取远程数据。
                    let _ =
                        tokio::fs::remove_file(
                            &self.cache_file
                        )
                        .await;

                    return Err(
                        CfProbeError::CacheCorrupted {
                            path:
                                self.cache_file
                                    .clone(),

                            reason:
                                error.to_string(),
                        }
                    );
                }
            };

        if cache.schema_version
            != CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION
        {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::CacheCorrupted {
                    path:
                        self.cache_file.clone(),

                    reason:
                        format!(
                            "unsupported schema version {}",
                            cache.schema_version
                        ),
                }
            );
        }

        if cache.ipv4_cidrs.is_empty()
            && cache.ipv6_cidrs.is_empty()
        {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::CacheCorrupted {
                    path:
                        self.cache_file.clone(),

                    reason:
                        "cache contains no IP ranges"
                            .to_string(),
                }
            );
        }

        // 提前验证 CIDR。
        CloudflareRanges::new(
            cache.ipv4_cidrs.clone(),
            cache.ipv6_cidrs.clone(),
            cache.etag.clone(),
        )?;

        Ok(Some(cache))
    }

    async fn write_disk_cache(
        &self,
        cache: &CacheFile,
    ) -> Result<(), CfProbeError> {
        let parent =
            self.cache_file
                .parent()
                .ok_or(
                    CfProbeError::CacheDirectoryUnavailable
                )?;

        tokio::fs::create_dir_all(parent)
            .await?;

        let content =
            serde_json::to_vec_pretty(cache)?;

        let cache_file =
            self.cache_file.clone();

        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(
            move || -> Result<(), CfProbeError> {
                let mut file =
                    AtomicWriteFile::open(
                        &cache_file
                    )
                    .map_err(
                        CfProbeError::Io
                    )?;

                use std::io::Write;

                file.write_all(&content)
                    .map_err(
                        CfProbeError::Io
                    )?;

                file.sync_all()
                    .map_err(
                        CfProbeError::Io
                    )?;

                file.commit()
                    .map_err(
                        CfProbeError::Io
                    )?;

                Ok(())
            },
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|error| {
            CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                format!(
                    "cache writer task failed: {error}"
                )
            )
        })??;

        Ok(())
    }

    async fn acquire_process_lock(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<std::fs::File, CfProbeError> {
        let parent =
            self.lock_file
                .parent()
                .ok_or(
                    CfProbeError::CacheDirectoryUnavailable
                )?
                .to_path_buf();

        tokio::fs::create_dir_all(&parent)
            .await?;

        let deadline =
            tokio::time::Instant::now()
                + self.config.lock_timeout;

        loop {
            let lock_path =
                self.lock_file.clone();

            let attempt =
                tokio::task::spawn_blocking(
                    move || -> Result<
                        std::fs::File,
                        std::io::Error,
                    > {
                        use std::fs::OpenOptions;

                        let file =
                            OpenOptions::new()
                                .read(true)
                                .write(true)
                                .create(true)
                                .open(
                                    lock_path
                                )?;

                        match file
                            .try_lock_exclusive()
                        {
                            Ok(()) => {
                                Ok(file)
                            }

                            Err(error)
                                if error.kind()
                                    == fs2::lock_contended_error()
                                        .kind() =>
                            {
                                Err(
                                    std::io::Error::new(
                                        std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock,
                                        "cache lock is busy",
                                    )
                                )
                            }

                            Err(error) => {
                                Err(error)
                            }
                        }
                    },
                )
                .await
                .map_err(|error| {
                    CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                        format!(
                            "cache lock task failed: {error}"
                        ),
                    )
                })?;

            match attempt {
                Ok(file) => {
                    return Ok(file);
                }

                Err(error)
                    if error.kind()
                        == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock =>
                {
                    if tokio::time::Instant::now()
                        >= deadline
                    {
                        return Err(
                            CfProbeError::CacheLockTimeout
                        );
                    }

                    tokio::time::sleep(
                        self.config
                            .lock_retry_interval
                    )
                    .await;
                }

                Err(error) => {
                    return Err(error.into());
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn current_unix_timestamp()
    -> Result<i64, CfProbeError>
{
    let duration =
        SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)?;

    let seconds: i64 =
        duration
            .as_secs()
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| {
                CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                    "timestamp overflow"
                        .to_string(),
                )
            })?;

    Ok(seconds)
}
```

---

# 5. 这里有一个设计细节非常重要

我们不是：

```text
线程 A
    ↓
HTTP

线程 B
    ↓
HTTP

线程 C
    ↓
HTTP
```

而是：

```text
Task A ──┐
Task B ──┼──> refresh_lock
Task C ──┘
              │
              ▼
         只有一个任务执行刷新
```

然后考虑多个进程：

```text
Process A
    │
    ├── refresh_lock
    │
    └── process file lock
              │
              ▼
        Cloudflare API


Process B
    │
    └── file lock blocked
```

`fs2` 的文件锁是 advisory lock，所以需要所有使用者都遵守同一个 lock protocol；我们这里所有 cfprobe 进程都使用同一个 `.lock` 文件，因此这个场景正合适。citeturn664931view0

# 6. 修改 provider.rs

现在 `provider.rs` 不再自己负责 HTTP 请求。

替换成：

```rust
use std::net::IpAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;

use crate::cloudflare::{
    CloudflareClient,
    CloudflareRanges,
};
use crate::cloudflare::cache::{
    CacheConfig,
    CacheResult,
    CacheSource,
    CloudflareRangeCache,
};
use crate::detector::{
    detect_cloudflare_ip,
    CloudflareIpDetection,
};
use crate::error::CfProbeError;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct CloudflareRangeProvider {
    cache: CloudflareRangeCache,
}

impl CloudflareRangeProvider {
    pub fn new(
        client: CloudflareClient,
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        Ok(Self {
            cache:
                CloudflareRangeCache::new(
                    client
                )?,
        })
    }

    pub fn with_cache_dir(
        client: CloudflareClient,
        cache_dir: impl AsRef<std::path::Path>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        Ok(Self {
            cache:
                CloudflareRangeCache::with_cache_dir(
                    client,
                    cache_dir,
                )?,
        })
    }

    pub fn with_config(
        mut self,
        config: CacheConfig,
    ) -> Self {
        self.cache =
            self.cache.with_config(
                config
            );

        self
    }

    pub async fn get(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<CacheResult, CfProbeError> {
        self.cache.get().await
    }

    pub async fn load(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<Arc<CloudflareRanges>, CfProbeError> {
        Ok(
            self.cache
                .get()
                .await?
                .ranges
        )
    }

    pub async fn contains(
        &self,
        ip: IpAddr,
    ) -> Result<
        CloudflareIpDetection,
        CfProbeError,
    > {
        let ranges =
            self.cache.get().await?;

        Ok(
            detect_cloudflare_ip(
                &ranges.ranges,
                ip,
            )
        )
    }
}

pub use crate::cloudflare::cache::{
    CacheConfig,
    CacheResult,
    CacheSource,
};
```

不过这里会出现一个 Rust 模块导出问题，我们下一步统一整理 `cloudflare/mod.rs`。

# 9. 一个小问题：provider.rs 中的重复导出

实际上我们不需要：

```rust
pub use crate::cloudflare::cache::{
    CacheConfig,
    CacheResult,
    CacheSource,
};
```

因为已经在：

```rust
cloudflare/mod.rs
```

导出了。

所以 provider.rs 最终应该直接：

```rust
use crate::cloudflare::cache::{
    CacheConfig,
    CacheResult,
    CloudflareRangeCache,
};
```

完整版本：

```rust
use std::net::IpAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;

use crate::cloudflare::{
    CloudflareClient,
    CloudflareRanges,
};

use crate::cloudflare::cache::{
    CacheConfig,
    CacheResult,
    CloudflareRangeCache,
};

use crate::detector::{
    detect_cloudflare_ip,
    CloudflareIpDetection,
};

use crate::error::CfProbeError;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct CloudflareRangeProvider {
    cache: CloudflareRangeCache,
}

impl CloudflareRangeProvider {
    pub fn new(
        client: CloudflareClient,
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        Ok(Self {
            cache:
                CloudflareRangeCache::new(
                    client
                )?,
        })
    }

    pub fn with_cache_dir(
        client: CloudflareClient,
        cache_dir: impl AsRef<std::path::Path>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        Ok(Self {
            cache:
                CloudflareRangeCache::with_cache_dir(
                    client,
                    cache_dir,
                )?,
        })
    }

    pub fn with_config(
        self,
        config: CacheConfig,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            cache:
                self.cache.with_config(
                    config
                ),
        }
    }

    pub async fn get(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<
        CacheResult,
        CfProbeError,
    > {
        self.cache.get().await
    }

    pub async fn load(
        &self,
    ) -> Result<
        Arc<CloudflareRanges>,
        CfProbeError,
    > {
        Ok(
            self.cache
                .get()
                .await?
                .ranges
        )
    }

    pub async fn contains(
        &self,
        ip: IpAddr,
    ) -> Result<
        CloudflareIpDetection,
        CfProbeError,
    > {
        let result =
            self.cache.get().await?;

        Ok(
            detect_cloudflare_ip(
                &result.ranges,
                ip,
            )
        )
    }
}
```

# 10. 现在缓存文件是什么样？

第一次成功启动后：

```text
~/.cache/cfprobe/cfprobe/
└── cloudflare-ip-ranges.json
```

Linux 上具体路径由 `ProjectDirs` 决定，通常会类似：

```text
~/.cache/cfprobe/cfprobe/cloudflare-ip-ranges.json
```

macOS 通常：

```text
~/Library/Caches/cfprobe/cfprobe/cloudflare-ip-ranges.json
```

Windows 则放在 LocalAppData 对应目录。citeturn595060search0turn595060search3

文件内容：

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "fetched_at_unix": 1786623456,
  "etag": "\"abc123\"",
  "ipv4_cidrs": [
    "173.245.48.0/20",
    "103.21.244.0/22",
    "103.22.200.0/22"
  ],
  "ipv6_cidrs": [
    "2400:cb00::/32",
    "2606:4700::/32"
  ]
}
```

这里的：

```text
schema_version
```

非常重要。

以后我们改变缓存格式：

```text
v1
 ↓
v2
```

可以直接检测：

```rust
if schema_version != CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION
```

而不是尝试解析未知格式。

---

# 11. 缓存生命周期

现在程序真正的行为是：

### 第一次运行

```text
Memory
 ↓
没有

Disk
 ↓
没有

Cloudflare API
 ↓
200

Disk Cache
 ↓
写入

Memory
 ↓
保存
```

---

### 第二次运行

```text
Memory
 ↓
没有，因为是新进程

Disk
 ↓
存在

age < 24h
 ↓
直接使用
```

完全不会访问 Cloudflare API。

---

### 24 小时以后

```text
Disk
 ↓
过期

File Lock
 ↓
获取

ETag
 ↓
If-None-Match

Cloudflare
 ↓
304
```

然后：

```text
fetched_at
```

更新成当前时间。

所以：

```text
304
```

也不会导致缓存不断老化。

---

# 12. 网络故障

例如 Cloudflare API：

```text
timeout
connection refused
DNS failure
502
503
429
```

如果本地缓存：

```text
age = 2 days
```

而：

```text
stale_if_error = 7 days
```

则：

```text
检测成功

source = StaleFallback
```

这是非常重要的。

否则你的 `cfprobe` 服务会出现一个很糟糕的问题：

```text
Cloudflare API 暂时故障
       ↓
所有检测都失败
```

实际生产系统不应该这样。

应该：

```text
Cloudflare API 故障
       ↓
继续使用最近成功的 IP 数据
       ↓
检测继续工作
```

---

# 13. 为什么 `StaleFallback` 也要暴露？

因为最终检测结果应该能够告诉上层：

```json
{
  "ip": "1.1.1.1",
  "is_cloudflare": true,
  "source": "stale_fallback"
}
```

而不是让用户误以为：

```text
这是刚刚从 Cloudflare 获取的新数据。
```

未来我们会把这个信息纳入最终 `Evidence`：

```text
Evidence {
    source: CloudflareIpRange,
    confidence: 1.0,
    freshness: Stale,
}
```

这样你的最终检测报告才会真正专业。

# 14. 添加缓存测试

创建：

```text
tests/cloudflare_cache.rs
```

先写基础测试：

```rust
use std::time::Duration;

use tempfile::TempDir;

use cfprobe::{
    CacheConfig,
    CacheSource,
    CloudflareClient,
    CloudflareRangeProvider,
};

#[tokio::test]
async fn cache_directory_is_created() {
    let temp_dir =
        TempDir::new().unwrap();

    let client =
        reqwest::Client::builder()
            .user_agent("cfprobe-test")
            .build()
            .unwrap();

    let provider =
        CloudflareRangeProvider::with_cache_dir(

                .into(),

    assert!(
        provider.is_ok()
    );
}
```

这里有一个问题：

`reqwest::Client` 不能直接 `into()` 成 `CloudflareClient`。

所以我们应该写成：

```rust
use cfprobe::{
    CloudflareClient,
    CloudflareRangeProvider,
};

#[tokio::test]
async fn cache_directory_is_created() {
    let temp_dir =
        tempfile::TempDir::new()
            .unwrap();

    let http =
        reqwest::Client::builder()
            .user_agent("cfprobe-test")

            .unwrap();

        CloudflareClient::new(http);

    let provider =
        CloudflareRangeProvider::with_cache_dir(
            client,
            temp_dir.path(),
        );

    assert!(
        provider.is_ok()
    );
}
```

# 17. 你的 example 最好也升级

`examples/ip_check.rs`：

```rust
use std::net::IpAddr;

use cfprobe::{
    CacheSource,
    CloudflareClient,
    CloudflareRangeProvider,
};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main()
    -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>>
{
    let http =
        reqwest::Client::builder()
            .user_agent("cfprobe/0.1")
            .build()?;

    let client =
        CloudflareClient::new(http);

    let provider =
        CloudflareRangeProvider::new(
            client
        )?;

    let result =
        provider.get().await?;

    println!(
        "cache source = {:?}",
        result.source
    );

    println!(
        "etag = {:?}",
        result.etag
    );

    println!(
        "fetched_at = {:?}",
        result.fetched_at
    );

    let ip: IpAddr =
        "1.1.1.1".parse()?;

    let detection =
        provider.contains(ip).await?;

    println!(
        "{detection:#?}"
    );

    if result.source
        == CacheSource::StaleFallback
    {
        eprintln!(
            "warning: using stale Cloudflare IP range cache"
        );
    }

    Ok(())
}
```

第一次：

```text
cache source = Network
etag = Some(...)
```

第二次：

```text
cache source = Disk
```

24 小时以后，如果服务器返回：

```text
304
```

则：

```text
cache source = NotModified
```

网络失败但旧缓存可用：

```text
cache source = StaleFallback
```

告诉用户。

# 19. Phase 2 现在实现了什么

已经达到：

```text
✅ Memory Cache
✅ Disk Cache
✅ TTL
✅ Stale Cache
✅ ETag
✅ If-None-Match
✅ 304
✅ Atomic Write
✅ Process-local Mutex
✅ Cross-process File Lock
✅ Lock Timeout
✅ Cache Schema Version
✅ Corrupt Cache Detection
✅ Network Failure Fallback
✅ IPv4
✅ IPv6
```

整个调用链现在是：

```text
provider.contains(ip)
        │
        ▼
CloudflareRangeCache.get()
        │
        ├── Memory fresh
        │      └── return
        │
        ├── Disk fresh
        │      └── return
        │
        ├── Process Mutex
        │
        ├── File Lock
        │
        ├── Re-check Disk
        │
        ├── Cloudflare API
        │      │
        │      ├── 304
        │      │
        │      └── 200
        │
        ├── Atomic Write
        │
        └── Memory Update
```

这部分已经和“把 IP 列表下载到文件”是完全不同的工程等级了。
