# 1. 先修正 Phase 2 的时间精度

之前是：

```rust
fetched_at_unix: i64
```

这是秒级时间。

对于：

```text
refresh_interval = 100ms
```

这种测试来说不够。

商业实现改成毫秒。

## 修改 `cache.rs`

把：

```rust
const CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION: u32 = 1;
```

改成：

```rust
const CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION: u32 = 2;
```

把：

```rust
fetched_at_unix: i64,
```

改成：

```rust
fetched_at_unix_ms: i64,
```

然后替换：

```rust
fn age(&self) -> Option<Duration> {
    let fetched_at =
        UNIX_EPOCH.checked_add(
            Duration::from_secs(
                self.fetched_at_unix
                    .try_into()
                    .ok()?,
            ),
        )?;

    SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(fetched_at)
        .ok()
}

fn fetched_at(&self) -> Option<SystemTime> {
    let seconds: u64 =
        self.fetched_at_unix.try_into().ok()?;

    UNIX_EPOCH.checked_add(
        Duration::from_secs(seconds),
    )
}
```

为：

```rust
fn age(&self) -> Option<Duration> {
    let millis: u64 =
        self.fetched_at_unix_ms.try_into().ok()?;

    let fetched_at =
        UNIX_EPOCH.checked_add(
            Duration::from_millis(millis),
        )?;

    SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(fetched_at)
        .ok()
}

fn fetched_at(&self) -> Option<SystemTime> {
    let millis: u64 =
        self.fetched_at_unix_ms.try_into().ok()?;

    UNIX_EPOCH.checked_add(
        Duration::from_millis(millis),
    )
}
```

然后把：

```rust
let now = current_unix_timestamp()?;
```

全部替换为：

```rust
let now = current_unix_timestamp_ms()?;
```

最后把：

```rust
fn current_unix_timestamp()
    -> Result<i64, CfProbeError>
{
    let duration =
        SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)?;

    let seconds: i64 =
        duration
            .as_secs()
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| {
                CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                    "timestamp overflow"
                        .to_string(),
                )
            })?;

    Ok(seconds)
}
```

替换成：

```rust
fn current_unix_timestamp_ms()
    -> Result<i64, CfProbeError>
{
    let duration =
        SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)?;

    let millis =
        duration
            .as_millis();

    i64::try_from(millis)
        .map_err(|_| {
            CfProbeError::InvalidResponse(
                "timestamp overflow"
                    .to_string(),
            )
        })
}
```

# 2. 修改所有 CacheFile 初始化

原来：

```rust
CacheFile {

}
```

全部变成：

# 3. 修复“损坏缓存自动恢复”

这是比较重要的。

原来的：

```rust
Err(error) => {
    let _ =
        tokio::fs::remove_file(
            &self.cache_file
        )
        .await;

    return Err(
        CfProbeError::CacheCorrupted {
            ...
        }
    );
}
```

我不建议这样。

如果缓存是：

```text
JSON 损坏
CIDR 损坏
schema 过期
```

这些属于**可恢复状态**。

正确流程应该：

```text
坏缓存
 ↓
删除
 ↓
Cloudflare API
 ↓
重新构建缓存
```

而真正应该返回 `Err` 的是：

```text
无法创建缓存目录
权限错误
无法建立网络连接且没有可用缓存
```

---

## 把 `read_disk_cache()` 修改成这个版本

```rust
async fn read_disk_cache(
    &self,
) -> Result<Option<CacheFile>, CfProbeError> {
    let bytes =
        match tokio::fs::read(
            &self.cache_file
        ).await {
            Ok(bytes) => bytes,

            Err(error)
                if error.kind()
                    == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound =>
            {
                return Ok(None);
            }

            Err(error) => {
                return Err(error.into());
            }
        };

    let cache: CacheFile =
        match serde_json::from_slice(
            &bytes
        ) {
            Ok(cache) => cache,

            Err(_) => {
                self.invalidate_disk_cache()
                    .await;

                return Ok(None);
            }
        };

    if cache.schema_version
        != CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION
    {
        self.invalidate_disk_cache()
            .await;

        return Ok(None);
    }

    if cache.ipv4_cidrs.is_empty()
        && cache.ipv6_cidrs.is_empty()
    {
        self.invalidate_disk_cache()
            .await;

        return Ok(None);
    }

    if CloudflareRanges::new(
        cache.ipv4_cidrs.clone(),
        cache.ipv6_cidrs.clone(),
        cache.etag.clone(),
    ).is_err() {
        self.invalidate_disk_cache()
            .await;

        return Ok(None);
    }

    Ok(Some(cache))
}
```

增加：

```rust
async fn invalidate_disk_cache(
    &self,
) {
    let _ =
        tokio::fs::remove_file(
            &self.cache_file
        )
        .await;
}
```

这样：

```text
损坏缓存
```

不会把：

```text
cfprobe
```

直接打死。

# 5. `tests/support/mock_cloudflare.rs`

完整代码：

```rust
use std::sync::{
    atomic::{
        AtomicUsize,
        Ordering,
    },
    Arc,
};

use tokio::{
    io::{
        AsyncReadExt,
        AsyncWriteExt,
    },
    net::TcpListener,
    sync::{
        oneshot,
        Mutex,
    },
    task::JoinHandle,
    time::{
        sleep,
        Duration,
    },
};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum MockMode {
    Ok,
    InternalServerError,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct MockState {
    request_count:
        Arc<AtomicUsize>,

    mode:
        Arc<Mutex<MockMode>>,

    etag:
        Arc<Mutex<String>>,

    delay:
        Arc<Mutex<Option<Duration>>>,
}

impl Default for MockState {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            request_count:
                Arc::new(
                    AtomicUsize::new(0)
                ),

            mode:
                Arc::new(
                    Mutex::new(
                        MockMode::Ok
                    )
                ),

            etag:
                Arc::new(
                    Mutex::new(
                        "\"test-etag-v1\""
                            .to_string()
                    )
                ),

            delay:
                Arc::new(
                    Mutex::new(None)
                ),
        }
    }
}

impl MockState {
    pub fn request_count(
        &self,
    ) -> usize {
        self.request_count
            .load(
                Ordering::SeqCst
            )
    }

    pub async fn set_mode(
        &self,
        mode: MockMode,
    ) {
        *self.mode.lock().await =
            mode;
    }

    pub async fn set_etag(
        &self,
        etag: &str,
    ) {
        *self.etag.lock().await =
            etag.to_string();
    }

    pub async fn set_delay(
        &self,
        delay: Option<Duration>,
    ) {
        *self.delay.lock().await =
            delay;
    }
}

pub struct MockCloudflareServer {
    pub endpoint: String,

    pub state: MockState,

    shutdown:
        Option<oneshot::Sender<()>>,

    task:
        Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl MockCloudflareServer {
    pub async fn start()
        -> Self
    {
        let listener =
            TcpListener::bind(
                "127.0.0.1:0"
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();

        let address =
            listener.local_addr()
                .unwrap();

        let state =
            MockState::default();

        let task_state =
            state.clone();

        let (
            shutdown_tx,
            mut shutdown_rx,
        ) = oneshot::channel();

        let task =
            tokio::spawn(async move {
                loop {
                    tokio::select! {
                        _ = &mut shutdown_rx => {
                            break;
                        }

                        result =
                            listener.accept() =>
                        {
                            let Ok((
                                socket,
                                _
                            )) = result
                            else {
                                continue;
                            };

                            let state =
                                task_state.clone();

                            tokio::spawn(
                                async move {
                                    handle_connection(
                                        socket,
                                        state,
                                    )
                                    .await;
                                }
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

        Self {
            endpoint:
                format!(
                    "http://{}",
                    address
                ),

            state,

            shutdown:
                Some(shutdown_tx),

            task:
                Some(task),
        }
    }
}

impl Drop
    for MockCloudflareServer
{
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(
            shutdown
        ) = self.shutdown.take() {
            let _ =
                shutdown.send(());
        }

        if let Some(task) =
            self.task.take()
        {
            task.abort();
        }
    }
}

async fn handle_connection(
    mut socket:
        tokio::net::TcpStream,

    state:
        MockState,
) {
    let mut buffer =
        vec![0u8; 8192];

    let mut request =
        Vec::new();

    loop {
        let read =
            socket
                .read(
                    &mut buffer
                )
                .await;

        let Ok(read) =
            read
        else {
            return;
        };

        if read == 0 {
            return;
        }

        request
            .extend_from_slice(
                &buffer[..read]
            );

        if request
            .windows(4)
            .any(
                |window|
                    window
                        == b"\r\n\r\n"
            )
        {
            break;
        }

        if request.len()
            > 64 * 1024
        {
            return;
        }
    }

    state.request_count
        .fetch_add(
            1,
            Ordering::SeqCst
        );

    let request =
        String::from_utf8_lossy(
            &request
        );

    let delay =
        *state.delay.lock().await;

    if let Some(delay) =
        delay
    {
        sleep(delay).await;
    }

    let mode =
        *state.mode.lock().await;

    if mode
        == MockMode::InternalServerError
    {
        write_response(
            &mut socket,
            500,
            "Internal Server Error",
            &[],
            b"server error",
        )
        .await;

        return;
    }

    let current_etag =
        state.etag
            .lock()
            .await
            .clone();

    let if_none_match =
        extract_header(
            &request,
            "If-None-Match",
        );

    if if_none_match
        .as_deref()
        == Some(
            current_etag.as_str()
        )
    {
        write_response(
            &mut socket,
            304,
            "Not Modified",
            &[
                (
                    "ETag",
                    current_etag.as_str()
                )
            ],
            &[],
        )
        .await;

        return;
    }

    let body =
        serde_json::json!({
            "success": true,
            "errors": [],
            "messages": [],
            "result": {
                "etag": current_etag,
                "ipv4_cidrs": [
                    "104.16.0.0/13"
                ],
                "ipv6_cidrs": [
                    "2606:4700::/32"
                ]
            }
        });

    let body =
        serde_json::to_vec(
            &body
        ).unwrap();

    write_response(
        &mut socket,
        200,
        "OK",
        &[
            (
                "Content-Type",
                "application/json",
            ),
            (
                "ETag",
                current_etag.as_str(),
            ),
        ],
        &body,
    )
    .await;
}

fn extract_header(
    request: &str,
    target: &str,
) -> Option<String> {
    for line
        in request.lines()
    {
        let Some((
            name,
            value,
        )) = line.split_once(':')
        else {
            continue;
        };

        if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(
            target
        ) {
            return Some(
                value.trim().to_string()
            );
        }
    }

    None
}

async fn write_response(
    socket:
        &mut tokio::net::TcpStream,

    status:
        u16,

    reason:
        &str,

    extra_headers:
        &[(&str, &str)],

    body:
        &[u8],
) {
    let mut response =
        format!(
            "HTTP/1.1 {} {}\r\n",
            status,
            reason,
        );

    response.push_str(
        &format!(
            "Content-Length: {}\r\n",
            body.len()
        )
    );

    response.push_str(
        "Connection: close\r\n"
    );

    for (
        name,
        value
    ) in extra_headers {
        response.push_str(
            &format!(
                "{}: {}\r\n",
                name,
                value,
            )
        );
    }

    response.push_str(
        "\r\n"
    );

    if socket
        .write_all(
            response.as_bytes()
        )
        .await
        .is_err()
    {
        return;
    }

    let _ =
        socket
            .write_all(body)
            .await;
}
```

这个服务器非常轻，不引入 Axum、Hyper Server 等框架。

对我们而言它只需要：

```text
GET
If-None-Match
ETag
200
304
500
delay
request_count
```

足够了。

```rust
async fn stale_cache_uses_etag_and_handles_304() {
    let server =
        MockCloudflareServer::start()
            .await;

        tempfile::TempDir::new()
            .unwrap();

    let http =
        reqwest::Client::new();

    let endpoint =
        format!(
            "{}/client/v4/ips",
            server.endpoint
        );

    let client =
        CloudflareClient::with_endpoint(
            http.clone(),
            endpoint.clone(),
        );

    let config =
        CacheConfig {
            refresh_interval:
                Duration::from_millis(0),

            stale_if_error:
                Duration::from_secs(60),

            ..CacheConfig::default()
        };

    let provider =
        CloudflareRangeProvider::with_cache_dir(
            client,
            temp.path(),
        )
        .unwrap()
        .with_config(config.clone());

    let first =
        provider.get()
            .await
            .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(
        first.source,
        CacheSource::Network
    );

    tokio::time::sleep(
        Duration::from_millis(10)
    )
    .await;

    let client2 =
        CloudflareClient::with_endpoint(
            http,
            endpoint,
        );

    let provider2 =
        CloudflareRangeProvider::with_cache_dir(
            client2,
            temp.path(),
        )
        .unwrap()
        .with_config(config);

    let second =
        provider2.get()
            .await
            .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(
        second.source,
        CacheSource::NotModified
    );

    assert_eq!(
        server.state.request_count(),
        2
    );
}
```

这里验证：

```text
第一次
    200

第二次
    If-None-Match
        ↓
    304
        ↓
    NotModified
```

# 13. 测试并发刷新

这个测试非常重要。

我们不只是测试：

```text
同一个 Provider
```

而是测试：

```text
Provider A
Provider B
```

分别代表两个独立实例/两个服务对象。

他们共享：

```text
同一个 cache directory
```

因此必须依赖：

```text
file lock
```

而不是仅靠 Tokio `Mutex`。

代码：

```rust
#[tokio::test]
async fn concurrent_providers_only_fetch_once() {
    let server =
        MockCloudflareServer::start()
            .await;

    server.state
        .set_delay(
            Some(
                Duration::from_millis(100)
            )
        )
        .await;

    let temp =
        tempfile::TempDir::new()
            .unwrap();

    let endpoint =
        format!(
            "{}/client/v4/ips",
            server.endpoint
        );

    let client1 =
        CloudflareClient::with_endpoint(
            reqwest::Client::new(),
            endpoint.clone(),
        );

    let client2 =
        CloudflareClient::with_endpoint(
            reqwest::Client::new(),
            endpoint,
        );

    let provider1 =
        CloudflareRangeProvider::with_cache_dir(
            client1,
            temp.path(),
        )
        .unwrap();

    let provider2 =
        CloudflareRangeProvider::with_cache_dir(
            client2,
            temp.path(),
        )
        .unwrap();

    let task1 =
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            provider1.get().await
        });

    let task2 =
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            provider2.get().await
        });

    let result1 =
        task1.await.unwrap().unwrap();

    let result2 =
        task2.await.unwrap().unwrap();

    assert_eq!(
        server.state.request_count(),
        1
    );

    assert!(
        result1.ranges.contains(
            "104.16.1.1"
                .parse()
                .unwrap()
        )
    );

    assert!(
        result2.ranges.contains(
            "104.16.1.1"
                .parse()
                .unwrap()
        )
    );
}
```

这里真正验证的是：

```text
Provider A                    Provider B
    │                              │
    ▼                              ▼
File Lock                       File Lock
    │                              │
    ▼                              │
Cloudflare API                    │
    │                              │
    ▼                              │
Write Cache                       │
    │                              │
Unlock                            │
                                   ▼
                             Re-read cache
                                   │
                                   ▼
                                Disk
```

所以：

```text
Cloudflare requests = 1
```

而不是：

```text
Cloudflare requests = 2
```

这对以后高并发 HTTP API 非常重要。

# 14. 测试网络超时

```rust
#[tokio::test]
async fn timeout_without_cache_returns_error() {
    let server =
        MockCloudflareServer::start()
            .await;

    server.state
        .set_delay(
            Some(
                Duration::from_millis(200)
            )
        )
        .await;

    let temp =
        tempfile::TempDir::new()
            .unwrap();

    let http =
        reqwest::Client::builder()
            .timeout(
                Duration::from_millis(50)
            )
            .build()
            .unwrap();

    let client =
        CloudflareClient::with_endpoint(
            http,
            format!(
                "{}/client/v4/ips",
                server.endpoint
            ),
        );

    let provider =
        CloudflareRangeProvider::with_cache_dir(
            client,
            temp.path(),
        )
        .unwrap();

    let result =
        provider.get().await;

    assert!(
        result.is_err()
    );
}
```

这保证了：

```text
没有 cache
+
没有网络
=
失败
```

这是正确的。

我们不应该返回：

```text
is_cloudflare = false
```

因为：

```text
Unknown
```

和：

```text
Not Cloudflare
```

是完全不同的语义。

# 19. Phase 2.5 完成后的质量保证

现在我们已经不是：

```text
“代码能运行”
```

而是有明确测试契约：

| 场景 | 预期 |
|---|---|
| 无缓存 + 200 | Network |
| 已有新缓存 | Disk |
| ETag + 304 | NotModified |
| API 500 + 可用旧缓存 | StaleFallback |
| API 500 + 无旧缓存 | Error |
| 超时 + 无旧缓存 | Error |
| JSON 损坏 | 自动恢复 |
| CIDR 损坏 | 自动恢复 |
| Schema 不支持 | 自动恢复 |
| 两个 Provider 并发刷新 | 只请求一次 |
| IPv4 | 正常 |
| IPv6 | 正常 |

这套测试会成为后面所有模块的基础。

---

# 20. 还有两个地方我建议现在就定死

### 第一：永远不要把 `Unknown` 当 `false`

这是网络探测器非常容易犯的错误。

例如：

```text
Cloudflare API timeout
```

不能输出：

```json
{
  "is_cloudflare": false
}
```

应该是：

```json
{
  "status": "unknown",
  "reason": "cloudflare_ip_ranges_unavailable"
}
```

否则你的检测结果会出现大量**假阴性**。

---

### 第二：缓存数据必须经过验证再进入内存

我们现在已经做到：

```text
Disk JSON
    ↓
schema
    ↓
non-empty
    ↓
CIDR parse
    ↓
CloudflareRanges
    ↓
Memory
```

而不是：

```text
磁盘 JSON
    ↓
直接信任
```

这是商业程序里非常重要的一层防御。

# 三、为什么选 Hickory

这里不要自己实现 DNS。

Hickory 的 `Resolver` 本身就是进程内异步 DNS resolver，不依赖操作系统的 `getaddrinfo()`；它支持 dual-stack A/AAAA、CNAME chain，并且 Resolver 自带 DNS response cache。([docs.rs](https://docs.rs/hickory-resolver/latest/hickory_resolver/))

这非常适合我们的用途：

```text
cfprobe
  ↓
DNS Backend
  ↓
Hickory
  ↓
UDP/TCP DNS
```

以后甚至可以扩展：

```text
UDP
TCP
DoT
DoH
DoQ
DoH3
```

Hickory 当前也提供这些可选协议。([docs.rs](https://docs.rs/hickory-resolver/latest/hickory_resolver/))

```rust
use std::net::IpAddr;

use async_trait::async_trait;

use crate::error::CfProbeError;

#[async_trait]
pub trait DnsBackend: Send + Sync {
    /// Resolve A + AAAA records.
    async fn lookup_ip(
        &self,
        fqdn: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<IpAddr>, CfProbeError>;

    /// Resolve direct CNAME records.
    async fn lookup_cname(
        &self,
        fqdn: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<String>, CfProbeError>;
}
```

# 八、Hickory Resolver

创建：

```text
src/dns/resolver.rs
```

```rust
use std::net::IpAddr;

use async_trait::async_trait;

use hickory_resolver::{
    config::{
        ResolverConfig,
        ResolverOpts,
        GOOGLE,
        CLOUDFLARE,
        QUAD9,
    },
    name_server::TokioConnectionProvider,
    proto::{
        rr::{
            RData,
            RecordType,
        },
    },
    Resolver,
};

use crate::error::CfProbeError;

use super::backend::DnsBackend;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct HickoryDnsResolver {
    resolver: Resolver<TokioConnectionProvider>,

    name: String,
}

impl HickoryDnsResolver {
    pub fn system(
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        let mut builder =
            Resolver::builder_tokio()
                .map_err(|error| {
                    CfProbeError::Dns {
                        message:
                            error.to_string(),
                    }
                })?;

        let mut opts =
            builder.options().clone();

        opts.timeout =
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(5);

        builder.options_mut().timeout =
            opts.timeout;

        let resolver =
            builder.build();

        Ok(Self {
            resolver,
            name:
                "system".to_string(),
        })
    }

    pub fn with_config(
        config: ResolverConfig,
        name: impl Into<String>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        let mut builder =
            Resolver::builder_with_config(
                config,
                TokioConnectionProvider::default(),
            );

        builder
            .options_mut()
            .timeout =
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(5);

        let resolver =
            builder.build();

        Ok(Self {
            resolver,
            name: name.into(),
        })
    }

    pub fn google(
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        Self::with_config(
            ResolverConfig::udp_and_tcp(&GOOGLE),
            "google",
        )
    }

    pub fn cloudflare(
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        Self::with_config(
            ResolverConfig::udp_and_tcp(
                &CLOUDFLARE
            ),
            "cloudflare",
        )
    }

    pub fn quad9(
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        Self::with_config(
            ResolverConfig::udp_and_tcp(
                &QUAD9
            ),
            "quad9",
        )
    }

    pub fn name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.name
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl DnsBackend for HickoryDnsResolver {
    async fn lookup_ip(
        &self,
        fqdn: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<IpAddr>, CfProbeError> {
        let lookup =
            self.resolver
                .lookup_ip(fqdn)
                .await
                .map_err(|error| {
                    CfProbeError::Dns {
                        message:
                            format!(
                                "{}: {}",
                                self.name,
                                error
                            ),
                    }
                })?;

        Ok(
            lookup
                .iter()
                .collect()
        )
    }

    async fn lookup_cname(
        &self,
        fqdn: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<String>, CfProbeError> {
        let lookup =
            self.resolver
                .lookup(
                    fqdn,
                    RecordType::CNAME,
                )
                .await
                .map_err(|error| {
                    CfProbeError::Dns {
                        message:
                            format!(
                                "{}: {}",
                                self.name,
                                error
                            ),
                    }
                })?;

        let mut result =
            Vec::new();

        for record
            in lookup.record_iter()
        {
            if let Some(
                RData::CNAME(cname)
            ) = record.data()
            {
                result.push(
                    cname.0.to_ascii()
                );
            }
        }

        Ok(result)
    }
}
```

Hickory 当前提供 `lookup_ip()` 做双栈 A/AAAA 查询，也提供通用 `lookup()` 做特定 RecordType 查询；这是我们这里分别提取 A/AAAA 和 CNAME 的依据。([docs.rs](https://docs.rs/hickory-resolver/latest/hickory_resolver/struct.Resolver.html))

# 十、规范化域名

创建：

```text
src/dns/mod.rs
```

我们先做一个标准化函数：

```rust
fn normalize_hostname(
    hostname: &str,
) -> Result<String, CfProbeError> {
    let hostname =
        hostname.trim();

    if hostname.is_empty() {
        return Err(
            CfProbeError::Dns {
                message:
                    "hostname is empty"
                        .to_string(),
            }
        );
    }

    let fqdn =
        if hostname.ends_with('.') {
            hostname.to_string()
        } else {
            format!("{hostname}.")
        };

    hickory_resolver::proto::rr::Name
        ::from_utf8(&fqdn)
        .map_err(|error| {
            CfProbeError::Dns {
                message:
                    format!(
                        "invalid hostname `{hostname}`: {error}"
                    ),
            }
        })?;

    Ok(
        fqdn.to_ascii_lowercase()
    )
}
```

这里非常重要：

```text
example.com
```

我们统一变成：

```text
example.com.
```

因为 Hickory 文档明确说明，使用以 `.` 结尾的 FQDN 可以避免 search-domain 逻辑带来的额外查询。([docs.rs](https://docs.rs/hickory-resolver/latest/hickory_resolver/struct.Resolver.html))

# 十一、CNAME Chain Resolver

DNS 不是：

```text
example.com
    ↓
CNAME
```

这么简单。

可能是：

```text
example.com.
    ↓
foo.example.net.
    ↓
bar.example.net.
    ↓
origin.example.org.
    ↓
A
```

所以我们不能只请求一次 CNAME。

创建：

```text
src/dns/detector.rs
```

先实现：

```rust
use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::net::IpAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;

use futures::future::join_all;

use crate::{
    CloudflareRanges,
    error::CfProbeError,
};

use super::{
    backend::DnsBackend,
    model::{
        DnsDetection,
        DnsDetectionStatus,
        ResolverObservation,
    },
};

const MAX_CNAME_DEPTH: usize = 16;

fn normalize_hostname(
    hostname: &str,
) -> Result<String, CfProbeError> {
    let hostname =
        hostname.trim();

    if hostname.is_empty() {
        return Err(
            CfProbeError::Dns {
                message:
                    "hostname is empty"
                        .to_string(),
            }
        );
    }

    let fqdn =
        if hostname.ends_with('.') {
            hostname.to_string()
        } else {
            format!("{hostname}.")
        };

    hickory_resolver::proto::rr::Name
        ::from_utf8(&fqdn)
        .map_err(|error| {
            CfProbeError::Dns {
                message:
                    format!(
                        "invalid hostname `{hostname}`: {error}"
                    ),
            }
        })?;

    Ok(
        fqdn.to_ascii_lowercase()
    )
}

async fn resolve_cname_chain(
    resolver: &dyn DnsBackend,
    hostname: &str,
) -> Result<Vec<String>, CfProbeError> {
    let mut chain =
        Vec::new();

    let mut current =
        hostname.to_string();

    let mut visited =
        HashSet::new();

    for _ in 0..MAX_CNAME_DEPTH {
        if !visited.insert(
            current.clone()
        ) {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::Dns {
                    message:
                        format!(
                            "CNAME loop detected at {current}"
                        ),
                }
            );
        }

        let cnames =
            resolver
                .lookup_cname(
                    &current
                )
                .await?;

        let Some(next) =
            cnames.first()
        else {
            break;
        };

        let next =
            if next.ends_with('.') {
                next.to_ascii_lowercase()
            } else {
                format!(
                    "{}.",
                    next.to_ascii_lowercase()
                )
            };

        chain.push(
            next.clone()
        );

        current =
            next;
    }

    if chain.len()
        >= MAX_CNAME_DEPTH
    {
        return Err(
            CfProbeError::Dns {
                message:
                    format!(
                        "CNAME chain exceeds maximum depth {}",
                        MAX_CNAME_DEPTH
                    ),
            }
        );
    }

    Ok(chain)
}
```

然后：

```rust
pub struct DnsDetector {
    resolvers:
        Vec<DnsResolverEntry>,

    min_successful_resolvers:
        usize,
}
```

构造：

```rust
impl DnsDetector {
    pub fn new(
        resolvers: Vec<DnsResolverEntry>,
    ) -> Self {
        let min_successful_resolvers =
            if resolvers.len() <= 1 {
                1
            } else {
                resolvers.len() / 2 + 1
            };

        Self {
            resolvers,
            min_successful_resolvers,
        }
    }

    pub fn with_min_successful_resolvers(
        mut self,
        value: usize,
    ) -> Self {
        self.min_successful_resolvers =
            value.max(1);

        self
    }
}
```

# 十三、真正的 DNS Detector

继续：

```rust
impl DnsDetector {
    pub async fn detect(
        &self,
        hostname: &str,
        cloudflare_ranges:
            &CloudflareRanges,
    ) -> Result<
        DnsDetection,
        CfProbeError,
    > {
        let normalized =
            normalize_hostname(
                hostname
            )?;

        if self.resolvers.is_empty() {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::Dns {
                    message:
                        "no DNS resolvers configured"
                            .to_string(),
                }
            );
        }

        let tasks =
            self.resolvers
                .iter()
                .map(|entry| {
                    let resolver =
                        entry.resolver.clone();

                    let name =
                        entry.name.clone();

                    let hostname =
                        normalized.clone();

                    async move {
                        resolve_one(
                            &name,
                            resolver,
                            &hostname,
                        )
                        .await
                    }
                });

        let results =
            join_all(tasks).await;

        let mut observations =
            Vec::with_capacity(
                results.len()
            );

        let mut union_ips =
            std::collections::BTreeSet::new();

        let mut cloudflare_ips =
            std::collections::BTreeSet::new();

        let mut successful_resolver_count =
            0usize;

        let mut cloudflare_resolver_count =
            0usize;

        for observation
            in results
        {
            if observation.success {
                successful_resolver_count += 1;

                let has_cf =
                    observation
                        .ips
                        .iter()
                        .any(
                            |ip|
                                cloudflare_ranges
                                    .contains(*ip)
                        );

                if has_cf {
                    cloudflare_resolver_count += 1;
                }

                for ip
                    in &observation.ips
                {
                    union_ips
                        .insert(*ip);

                    if cloudflare_ranges
                        .contains(*ip)
                    {
                        cloudflare_ips
                            .insert(*ip);
                    }
                }
            }

            observations.push(
                observation
            );
        }

        let has_cloudflare_ip =
            cloudflare_resolver_count
                >= self.min_successful_resolvers
                && !cloudflare_ips.is_empty();

        let status =
            if successful_resolver_count
                < self.min_successful_resolvers
            {
                DnsDetectionStatus::Unknown
            } else if has_cloudflare_ip {
                DnsDetectionStatus::CloudflareIp
            } else {
                DnsDetectionStatus::NoCloudflareIp
            };

        Ok(DnsDetection {
            hostname:
                hostname.to_string(),

            normalized_hostname:
                normalized,

            observations,

            union_ips:
                union_ips
                    .into_iter()
                    .collect(),

            cloudflare_ips:
                cloudflare_ips
                    .into_iter()
                    .collect(),

            cloudflare_resolver_count,

            successful_resolver_count,

            resolver_count:
                self.resolvers.len(),

            all_resolvers_agree:
                successful_resolver_count
                    == self.resolvers.len(),

            has_cloudflare_ip,

            status,
        })
    }
}
```

# 十四、单个 DNS Resolver

实现：

```rust
async fn resolve_one(
    name: &str,
    resolver: Arc<dyn DnsBackend>,
    hostname: &str,
) -> ResolverObservation {
    let ips =
        match resolver
            .lookup_ip(hostname)
            .await
        {
            Ok(ips) => ips,

            Err(error) => {
                return ResolverObservation {
                    resolver:
                        name.to_string(),

                    success:
                        false,

                    ips:
                        Vec::new(),

                    cname_chain:
                        Vec::new(),

                    error:
                        Some(error.to_string()),
                };
            }
        };

    let cname_chain =
        match resolve_cname_chain(
            resolver.as_ref(),
            hostname,
        )
        .await
        {
            Ok(chain) => chain,

            Err(error) => {
                return ResolverObservation {
                    resolver:
                        name.to_string(),

                    success:
                        false,

                    ips,

                    cname_chain:
                        Vec::new(),

                    error:
                        Some(
                            error.to_string()
                        ),
                };
            }
        };

    ResolverObservation {
        resolver:
            name.to_string(),

        success:
            true,

        ips,

        cname_chain,

        error:
            None,
    }
}
```

---

# 十五、这里有一个非常关键的设计

现在我们用了：

```text
3 个 Resolver
```

比如：

```text
Google
Cloudflare
Quad9
```

结果：

```text
Google
    ↓
104.16.x.x

Cloudflare
    ↓
104.16.x.x

Quad9
    ↓
104.16.x.x
```

那么：

```text
3 / 3
```

都命中 Cloudflare。

这个 DNS 信号非常强。

---

另一种：

```text
Google
    ↓
104.16.x.x

Cloudflare
    ↓
104.16.x.x

Quad9
    ↓
1.2.3.4
```

现在：

```text
Cloudflare consensus = 2 / 3
```

仍然可以认为：

```text
Cloudflare DNS evidence
```

但：

```text
all_resolvers_agree = false
```

最终 Evidence Engine 可以降低置信度。

---

第三种：

```text
Google
    ↓
timeout

Cloudflare
    ↓
timeout

Quad9
    ↓
1.2.3.4
```

那么：

```text
successful = 1
minimum = 2
```

最终：

```text
Unknown
```

这比强行：

```text
NoCloudflare
```

专业得多。

```text
mode = multi
```

# 二十一、测试必须脱离真实 DNS

这一点和 Phase 2.5 一样。

我们增加一个测试 resolver：

```rust
struct MockDnsResolver {
    ips:
        Vec<IpAddr>,

    cname_chain:
        Vec<String>,

    fail:
        bool,
}
```

实现：

```rust
#[async_trait]
impl DnsBackend for MockDnsResolver {
    async fn lookup_ip(
        &self,
        _fqdn: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<IpAddr>, CfProbeError> {
        if self.fail {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::Dns {
                    message:
                        "mock DNS failure"
                            .to_string(),
                }
            );
        }

        Ok(self.ips.clone())
    }

    async fn lookup_cname(
        &self,
        _fqdn: &str,
    ) -> Result<Vec<String>, CfProbeError> {
        if self.fail {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::Dns {
                    message:
                        "mock DNS failure"
                            .to_string(),
                }
            );
        }

        Ok(
            self.cname_chain
                .first()
                .cloned()
                .into_iter()
                .collect()
        )
    }
}
```

# 二十八、Phase 3 为什么不直接说“DNS = Cloudflare”

这是整个项目特别关键的一点。

例如：

```text
example.com
       ↓
104.16.1.1
```

可以得出：

```text
DNS currently points to Cloudflare network
```

但不能严谨地得出：

```text
example.com definitely uses Cloudflare reverse proxy
```

因为 DNS 只是其中一个证据。

最终我们要：

```text
DNS
 +
TLS
 +
HTTP
 +
IP ASN
 +
Cloudflare IP Range
```

一起判断。

---

# 二十九、DNS 层最终输出应该是 Evidence

Phase 6 我们会统一成：

```rust
pub struct Evidence {
    pub kind: EvidenceKind,

    pub source:
        EvidenceSource,

    pub confidence:
        f32,

    pub details:
        serde_json::Value,
}
```

例如 DNS：

```text
Evidence
├── kind = DnsResolvesToCloudflare
├── confidence = 0.95
├── resolver_agreement = 3/3
└── ips = [...]
```

如果：

```text
2/3
```

则：

```text
confidence = 0.80
```

如果：

```text
1/3
```

则可能：

```text
Unknown / weak
```

这个会在 Phase 6 统一处理。

# 三十、一个重要改进：DNS 缓存

Hickory 自身已经有 response cache；文档说明 Resolver 内部能够缓存 DNS 查询结果，而且还有 `clear_lookup_cache()` 等接口。([docs.rs](https://docs.rs/hickory-resolver/latest/hickory_resolver/struct.Resolver.html))

因此这一阶段：

**不要再自己套一层永久 DNS cache。**

最终结构：

```text
DNS Detector
    ↓
Hickory Resolver
    ↓
Hickory internal DNS cache
    ↓
Upstream DNS
```

而 Cloudflare IP Range：

```text
Detector
    ↓
CloudflareRangeProvider
    ↓
我们自己控制的 Disk/Memory cache
```

这两个缓存体系保持独立。

原因非常简单：

```text
Cloudflare IP ranges
```

是我们的静态外部 metadata。

而：

```text
DNS answers
```

必须按照 DNS TTL 管理。

所以不要自己擅自给 DNS 结果设置：

```text
24h cache
```

这会破坏 DNS TTL 语义。

---

# 三十一、Phase 3 的安全边界

DNS Detector 现在已经防御这些问题：

```text
✅ 空 hostname
✅ 非法 hostname
✅ DNS timeout
✅ DNS resolver failure
✅ CNAME loop
✅ CNAME depth explosion
✅ IPv4
✅ IPv6
✅ Resolver disagreement
✅ Resolver quorum
✅ DNS false-negative protection
```

CNAME 最大 16 层：

```rust
const MAX_CNAME_DEPTH: usize = 16;
```

这不是随便写的，而是为了避免：

```text
恶意 DNS
  ↓
CNAME A
  ↓
CNAME B
  ↓
CNAME C
  ↓
...
```

造成无限解析。

---

# 三十二、还有一个更重要的设计：不要扫描所有 DNS Record

当前阶段我们只需要：

```text
A
AAAA
CNAME
```

暂时不要：

```text
ANY
TXT
MX
NS
SOA
SRV
```

因为我们的目标是：

```text
Cloudflare CDN Detection
```

不是：

```text
DNS Enumeration
```

这能明显降低查询量和隐私暴露。

# 三十四、Phase 3 完成后的整体架构

现在：

```text
                         cfprobe
                            │
              ┌─────────────┴──────────────┐
              │                            │
       Cloudflare Range                DNS Detector
          Provider                         │
              │                     ┌──────┴───────┐
              │                     │              │
          IP Ranges              Resolver A    Resolver B
              │                     │              │
              │                     └──────┬───────┘
              │                            │
              └──────────────┬─────────────┘
                             │
                       Detection Evidence
```

目前可以回答：

```text
这个 IP
    ↓
是不是 Cloudflare 官方 Edge IP？

某个 hostname
    ↓
DNS 是否解析到了 Cloudflare Edge？
```

但是还不能严谨回答：

```text
这个 IP + hostname
    ↓
是不是 Cloudflare Reverse Proxy？
```

因为还缺最关键的一层：

```text
TLS/SNI
```

---

# 三十五、Phase 4 会做什么

下一阶段应该进入 **TCP + TLS Detector**。

目标：

```text
IP
+
Hostname
        │
        ▼
TCP connect
        │
        ▼
TLS ClientHello
        │
        ├── SNI = hostname
        ├── ALPN
        ├── TLS version
        ├── Certificate
        ├── SAN
        ├── Issuer
        └── fingerprint
```

特别重要的是：

```text
104.16.x.x:443
          +
SNI = example.com
```

而不是：

```text
https://104.16.x.x
```

这正好与我们最开始确定的：

```text
IP + Host
```

检测模型一致。

Phase 4 我会把 TLS 层也设计成和 DNS 一样的 `Evidence` 来源，并且实现**不验证证书也能读取证书链信息、SNI、ALPN，同时支持 TLS 握手超时和 IPv4/IPv6**，然后再进入 Phase 5 的 HTTP `CF-Ray / CF-Cache-Status / Server` 探测。

另外，我重新检查了一下我们目前 Phase 1、2、2.5、3 的结构，Phase 3 目前还需要整理一下，特别是 `dns/mod.rs`、`dns/detector.rs`、`dns/resolver.rs` 之间的职责。我们不要继续在有歧义的状态上往 Phase 4 堆代码。

# 2. 修改 `src/error.rs`

### 【修改】

`src/error.rs`

在之前的 `CfProbeError` 中加入：

```rust
Dns {
    message: String,
},
```

完整文件建议整理成：

```rust
use std::fmt;
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum CfProbeError {
    Http(reqwest::Error),

    Io(std::io::Error),

    Json(serde_json::Error),

    Dns {
        message: String,
    },

    InvalidResponse(String),

    InvalidCidr {
        value: String,
        reason: String,
    },

    CacheCorrupted {
        path: PathBuf,
        reason: String,
    },

    CacheLockTimeout,

    CacheDirectoryUnavailable,

    SystemClock(std::time::SystemTimeError),
}

impl fmt::Display for CfProbeError {
    fn fmt(
        &self,
        f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>,
    ) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Http(error) => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "HTTP request failed: {error}"
                )
            }

            Self::Io(error) => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "I/O error: {error}"
                )
            }

            Self::Json(error) => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "JSON error: {error}"
                )
            }

            Self::Dns { message } => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "DNS resolution failed: {message}"
                )
            }

            Self::InvalidResponse(message) => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "invalid Cloudflare API response: {message}"
                )
            }

            Self::InvalidCidr {
                value,
                reason,
            } => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "invalid CIDR `{value}`: {reason}"
                )
            }

            Self::CacheCorrupted {
                path,
                reason,
            } => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "cache file `{}` is corrupted: {reason}",
                    path.display()
                )
            }

            Self::CacheLockTimeout => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "timed out waiting for Cloudflare cache lock"
                )
            }

            Self::CacheDirectoryUnavailable => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "unable to determine a platform cache directory"
                )
            }

            Self::SystemClock(error) => {
                write!(
                    f,
                    "system clock error: {error}"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for CfProbeError {}

impl From<reqwest::Error>
    for CfProbeError
{
    fn from(
        value: reqwest::Error,
    ) -> Self {
        Self::Http(value)
    }
}

impl From<std::io::Error>
    for CfProbeError
{
    fn from(
        value: std::io::Error,
    ) -> Self {
        Self::Io(value)
    }
}

impl From<serde_json::Error>
    for CfProbeError
{
    fn from(
        value: serde_json::Error,
    ) -> Self {
        Self::Json(value)
    }
}

impl From<std::time::SystemTimeError>
    for CfProbeError
{
    fn from(
        value: std::time::SystemTimeError,
    ) -> Self {
        Self::SystemClock(value)
    }
}
```

# 5. 修改/重写 `src/dns/resolver.rs`

### 【修改】

文件：

```text
src/dns/resolver.rs
```

完整替换为：

```rust
use std::net::IpAddr;
use std::time::Duration;

use async_trait::async_trait;

use hickory_resolver::{
    config::{
        ResolverConfig,
        ResolverOpts,
        CLOUDFLARE,
        GOOGLE,
        QUAD9,
    },
    name_server::TokioConnectionProvider,
    proto::rr::{
        RData,
        RecordType,
    },
    Resolver,
};

use crate::error::CfProbeError;

use super::backend::DnsBackend;

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct HickoryDnsResolver {
    resolver:
        Resolver<TokioConnectionProvider>,

    name: String,
}

impl HickoryDnsResolver {
    pub fn system()
        -> Result<Self, CfProbeError>
    {
        let mut opts =
            ResolverOpts::default();

        opts.timeout =
            Duration::from_secs(5);

        opts.attempts = 2;

        let resolver =
            Resolver::builder_tokio()
                .map_err(|error| {
                    CfProbeError::Dns {
                        message:
                            error.to_string(),
                    }
                })?
                .with_options(opts)
                .build();

        Ok(Self {
            resolver,
            name: "system".to_string(),
        })
    }

    pub fn with_config(
        config: ResolverConfig,
        name: impl Into<String>,
    ) -> Result<Self, CfProbeError> {
        let mut opts =
            ResolverOpts::default();

        opts.timeout =
            Duration::from_secs(5);

        opts.attempts = 2;

        let resolver =
            Resolver::builder_tokio()
                .map_err(|error| {
                    CfProbeError::Dns {
                        message:
                            error.to_string(),
                    }
                })?
                .with_config(config)
                .with_options(opts)
                .build();

        Ok(Self {
            resolver,
            name: name.into(),
        })
    }

    pub fn google()
        -> Result<Self, CfProbeError>
    {
        Self::with_config(
            ResolverConfig::udp_and_tcp(
                &GOOGLE,
            ),
            "google",
        )
    }

    pub fn cloudflare()
        -> Result<Self, CfProbeError>
    {
        Self::with_config(
            ResolverConfig::udp_and_tcp(
                &CLOUDFLARE,
            ),
            "cloudflare",
        )
    }

    pub fn quad9()
        -> Result<Self, CfProbeError>
    {
        Self::with_config(
            ResolverConfig::udp_and_tcp(
                &QUAD9,
            ),
            "quad9",
        )
    }

    pub fn name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.name
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl DnsBackend
    for HickoryDnsResolver
{
    async fn lookup_ip(
        &self,
        fqdn: &str,
    ) -> Result<
        Vec<IpAddr>,
        CfProbeError,
    > {
        let lookup =
            self.resolver
                .lookup_ip(fqdn)
                .await
                .map_err(|error| {
                    CfProbeError::Dns {
                        message:
                            format!(
                                "{}: {}",
                                self.name,
                                error,
                            ),
                    }
                })?;

        Ok(
            lookup
                .iter()
                .collect()
        )
    }

    async fn lookup_cname(
        &self,
        fqdn: &str,
    ) -> Result<
        Vec<String>,
        CfProbeError,
    > {
        let lookup =
            self.resolver
                .lookup(
                    fqdn,
                    RecordType::CNAME,
                )
                .await
                .map_err(|error| {
                    CfProbeError::Dns {
                        message:
                            format!(
                                "{}: {}",
                                self.name,
                                error,
                            ),
                    }
                })?;

        let mut result =
            Vec::new();

        for record
            in lookup.record_iter()
        {
            if let Some(
                RData::CNAME(cname),
            ) = record.data()
            {
                result.push(
                    cname.0.to_ascii(),
                );
            }
        }

        Ok(result)
    }
}
```

这里开始，我们以后只通过 `DnsBackend` 使用它。

# 6. 新增 `src/dns/detector.rs`

### 【新增】

文件：

```text
src/dns/detector.rs
```

完整内容：

```rust
use std::collections::{
    BTreeSet,
    HashSet,
};

use std::sync::Arc;

use futures::future::join_all;

use crate::{
    cloudflare::CloudflareRanges,
    error::CfProbeError,
};

use super::{
    backend::DnsBackend,
    model::{
        DnsDetection,
        DnsDetectionStatus,
        ResolverObservation,
    },
};

const MAX_CNAME_DEPTH: usize = 16;

pub struct DnsResolverEntry {
    pub name: String,

    pub resolver:
        Arc<dyn DnsBackend>,
}

pub struct DnsDetector {
    resolvers:
        Vec<DnsResolverEntry>,

    min_successful_resolvers:
        usize,
}

impl DnsDetector {
    pub fn new(
        resolvers:
            Vec<DnsResolverEntry>,
    ) -> Self {
        let min_successful_resolvers =
            if resolvers.len() <= 1 {
                1
            } else {
                resolvers.len() / 2 + 1
            };

        Self {
            resolvers,

            min_successful_resolvers,
        }
    }

    pub fn with_min_successful_resolvers(
        mut self,
        value: usize,
    ) -> Self {
        self.min_successful_resolvers =
            value.max(1);

        self
    }

    pub async fn detect(
        &self,
        hostname: &str,
        cloudflare_ranges:
            &CloudflareRanges,
    ) -> Result<
        DnsDetection,
        CfProbeError,
    > {
        let normalized =
            normalize_hostname(
                hostname,
            )?;

        if self.resolvers.is_empty() {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::Dns {
                    message:
                        "no DNS resolvers configured"
                            .to_string(),
                },
            );
        }

        let tasks =
            self.resolvers
                .iter()
                .map(|entry| {
                    let resolver =
                        entry.resolver
                            .clone();

                    let name =
                        entry.name
                            .clone();

                    let hostname =
                        normalized
                            .clone();

                    async move {
                        resolve_one(
                            &name,
                            resolver,
                            &hostname,
                        )
                        .await
                    }
                });

        let results =
            join_all(tasks).await;

        let mut observations =
            Vec::with_capacity(
                results.len(),
            );

        let mut union_ips =
            BTreeSet::new();

        let mut cloudflare_ips =
            BTreeSet::new();

        let mut successful_resolver_count =
            0usize;

        let mut cloudflare_resolver_count =
            0usize;

        for observation
            in results
        {
            if observation.success {
                successful_resolver_count += 1;

                let has_cloudflare =
                    observation.ips.iter()
                        .any(|ip| {
                            cloudflare_ranges
                                .contains(*ip)
                        });

                if has_cloudflare {
                    cloudflare_resolver_count += 1;
                }

                for ip
                    in &observation.ips
                {
                    union_ips.insert(*ip);

                    if cloudflare_ranges
                        .contains(*ip)
                    {
                        cloudflare_ips
                            .insert(*ip);
                    }
                }
            }

            observations.push(
                observation,
            );
        }

        let all_resolvers_agree =
            successful_resolver_count
                == self.resolvers.len();

        let has_cloudflare_ip =
            cloudflare_resolver_count
                >= self
                    .min_successful_resolvers
                && !cloudflare_ips.is_empty();

        let status =
            if successful_resolver_count
                < self
                    .min_successful_resolvers
            {
                DnsDetectionStatus::Unknown
            } else if has_cloudflare_ip {
                DnsDetectionStatus::CloudflareIp
            } else {
                DnsDetectionStatus::NoCloudflareIp
            };

        Ok(DnsDetection {
            hostname:
                hostname.to_string(),

            normalized_hostname:
                normalized,

            observations,

            union_ips:
                union_ips
                    .into_iter()
                    .collect(),

            cloudflare_ips:
                cloudflare_ips
                    .into_iter()
                    .collect(),

            cloudflare_resolver_count,

            successful_resolver_count,

            resolver_count:
                self.resolvers.len(),

            all_resolvers_agree,

            has_cloudflare_ip,

            status,
        })
    }
}

async fn resolve_one(
    name: &str,
    resolver:
        Arc<dyn DnsBackend>,
    hostname: &str,
) -> ResolverObservation {
    let ips =
        match resolver
            .lookup_ip(hostname)
            .await
        {
            Ok(ips) => ips,

            Err(error) => {
                return ResolverObservation {
                    resolver:
                        name.to_string(),

                    success:
                        false,

                    ips:
                        Vec::new(),

                    cname_chain:
                        Vec::new(),

                    error:
                        Some(
                            error.to_string(),
                        ),
                };
            }
        };

    let cname_chain =
        match resolve_cname_chain(
            resolver.as_ref(),
            hostname,
        )
        .await
        {
            Ok(chain) => chain,

            Err(error) => {
                return ResolverObservation {
                    resolver:
                        name.to_string(),

                    success:
                        false,

                    ips,

                    cname_chain:
                        Vec::new(),

                    error:
                        Some(
                            error.to_string(),
                        ),
                };
            }
        };

    ResolverObservation {
        resolver:
            name.to_string(),

        success:
            true,

        ips,

        cname_chain,

        error:
            None,
    }
}

async fn resolve_cname_chain(
    resolver:
        &dyn DnsBackend,
    hostname: &str,
) -> Result<
    Vec<String>,
    CfProbeError,
> {
    let mut chain =
        Vec::new();

    let mut current =
        hostname.to_string();

    let mut visited =
        HashSet::new();

    for _ in 0..MAX_CNAME_DEPTH {
        if !visited.insert(
            current.clone(),
        ) {
            return Err(
                CfProbeError::Dns {
                    message:
                        format!(
                            "CNAME loop detected at {current}",
                        ),
                },
            );
        }

        let cnames =
            resolver
                .lookup_cname(
                    &current,
                )
                .await?;

        let Some(next) =
            cnames.first()
        else {
            break;
        };

        let next =
            if next.ends_with('.') {
                next.to_ascii_lowercase()
            } else {
                format!(
                    "{}.",
                    next.to_ascii_lowercase(),
                )
            };

        chain.push(
            next.clone(),
        );

        current = next;
    }

    if chain.len()
        >= MAX_CNAME_DEPTH
    {
        return Err(
            CfProbeError::Dns {
                message:
                    format!(
                        "CNAME chain exceeds maximum depth {}",
                        MAX_CNAME_DEPTH,
                    ),
            },
        );
    }

    Ok(chain)
}

fn normalize_hostname(
    hostname: &str,
) -> Result<String, CfProbeError> {
    let hostname =
        hostname.trim();

    if hostname.is_empty() {
        return Err(
            CfProbeError::Dns {
                message:
                    "hostname is empty"
                        .to_string(),
            },
        );
    }

    let fqdn =
        if hostname.ends_with('.') {
            hostname.to_string()
        } else {
            format!("{hostname}.")
        };

    hickory_resolver::proto::rr::Name
        ::from_utf8(&fqdn)
        .map_err(|error| {
            CfProbeError::Dns {
                message:
                    format!(
                        "invalid hostname `{hostname}`: {error}",
                    ),
            }
        })?;

    Ok(
        fqdn.to_ascii_lowercase()
    )
}
```

这样你知道这一整块代码**全部放在 `src/dns/detector.rs`**，不是 `mod.rs`。

这一阶段我们实现：

```text id="6k6pda"
Phase 4
├── TCP connect
├── TLS handshake
├── SNI
├── ALPN
├── TLS 1.2 / TLS 1.3
├── Cipher Suite
├── Certificate Chain
├── Certificate Subject
├── Certificate Issuer
├── Certificate SAN
├── Certificate SHA-256 fingerprint
├── Certificate verification result
├── TLS handshake error classification
├── IP + Host 强制连接
└── Offline integration tests
```

这里采用 `rustls 0.23 + tokio-rustls 0.26`。当前 `tokio-rustls 0.26.4` 基于 `rustls 0.23.x`，并提供 Tokio 异步 TLS Connector。Rustls 0.23 默认使用 AWS-LC-RS 作为 crypto provider，同时支持 TLS 1.2/1.3。citeturn109360search14turn107876search0turn107876search2

证书解析使用 `x509-parser 0.18.1`，它可以解析 DER 编码的 X.509 证书，并读取 Subject、Issuer、SAN 等字段。citeturn619085search5turn619085search6

# 二、为什么 Phase 4 不直接用 Reqwest

前面的 HTTP 探测我们会使用 Reqwest。

但 TLS Detector 我建议直接：

```text
TcpStream
    ↓
rustls
    ↓
tokio-rustls
```

原因是我们需要直接观察：

```text id="h5l9j4"
SNI
ALPN
TLS version
Cipher suite
Certificate chain
```

`tokio-rustls::TlsConnector` 可以直接对指定的 `TcpStream` 做 TLS handshake，而且可以使用 `ServerName` 作为 SNI。citeturn199953search2turn199953search12

这样可以明确实现：

```text id="nwe4zq"
TCP destination = 104.16.77.250:443

TLS SNI = example.com
```

这正是我们这个项目需要的。

# 六、新增 `src/tls/verifier.rs`

这里是本 Phase 最特殊的文件。

我们的 TLS 探测实际上需要两个模式：

### 第一种

正常证书验证：

```text id="m3p7b2"
TLS handshake
    ↓
验证 CA
验证域名
验证有效期
    ↓
成功
```

### 第二种

如果正常验证失败：

```text id="n0u0b1"
TLS handshake
    ↓
Certificate invalid
    ↓
Observation-only TLS
    ↓
仍然完成 TLS 握手
    ↓
读取 Certificate
```

否则：

```text id="rf9ik0"
证书过期
```

我们根本拿不到证书详细信息。

但这个第二阶段 verifier **不是简单关闭 TLS 加密**，仍然要求 TLS handshake cryptographic signatures 正确；它只是跳过证书链信任、名称和有效期判断，让 Detector 能够观察远端证书。

Rustls 官方把这种自定义 certificate verifier 放在 `dangerous()` API 下，并明确要求谨慎使用。citeturn490834view0turn490834search5

## 【新增】

文件：

```text id="6fjfrg"
src/tls/verifier.rs
```

完整内容：

```rust id="03dlil"
use std::fmt;
use std::sync::Arc;

use rustls::{
    client::danger::{
        HandshakeSignatureValid,
        ServerCertVerified,
        ServerCertVerifier,
    },
    crypto::{
        verify_tls12_signature,
        verify_tls13_signature,
        WebPkiSupportedAlgorithms,
    },
    pki_types::{
        CertificateDer,
        DigitallySignedStruct,
        ServerName,
        UnixTime,
    },
    Error,
};

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct ObservationVerifier {
    algorithms:
        WebPkiSupportedAlgorithms,
}

impl ObservationVerifier {
    pub fn new(
        algorithms:
            WebPkiSupportedAlgorithms,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            algorithms,
        }
    }

    pub fn into_arc(
        self,
    ) -> Arc<Self> {
        Arc::new(self)
    }
}

impl fmt::Debug
    for ObservationVerifier
{
    fn fmt(
        &self,
        f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>,
    ) -> fmt::Result {
        f.debug_struct(
            "ObservationVerifier",
        )
        .finish()
    }
}

impl ServerCertVerifier
    for ObservationVerifier
{
    fn verify_server_cert(
        &self,

        _end_entity:
            &CertificateDer<'_>,

        _intermediates:
            &[CertificateDer<'_>],

        _server_name:
            &ServerName<'_>,

        _ocsp_response:
            &[u8],

        _now:
            UnixTime,
    ) -> Result<
        ServerCertVerified,
        Error,
    > {
        /*
         * Important:
         *
         * This verifier is ONLY used by the TLS
         * observation path.
         *
         * It deliberately does not validate:
         *
         * - trust chain
         * - hostname
         * - expiration
         * - revocation
         *
         * The TLS cryptographic handshake signatures
         * are still verified below.
         */
        Ok(
            ServerCertVerified::assertion()
        )
    }

    fn verify_tls12_signature(
        &self,

        message:
            &[u8],

        cert:
            &CertificateDer<'_>,

        dss:
            &DigitallySignedStruct,
    ) -> Result<
        HandshakeSignatureValid,
        Error,
    > {
        verify_tls12_signature(
            message,
            cert,
            dss,
            &self.algorithms,
        )
    }

    fn verify_tls13_signature(
        &self,

        message:
            &[u8],

        cert:
            &CertificateDer<'_>,

        dss:
            &DigitallySignedStruct,
    ) -> Result<
        HandshakeSignatureValid,
        Error,
    > {
        verify_tls13_signature(
            message,
            cert,
            dss,
            &self.algorithms,
        )
    }

    fn supported_verify_schemes(
        &self,
    ) -> Vec<rustls::SignatureScheme> {
        self.algorithms
            .supported_schemes()
    }

    fn requires_raw_public_keys(
        &self,
    ) -> bool {
        false
    }

    fn root_hint_subjects(
        &self,
    ) -> Option<
        &[rustls::DistinguishedName]
    > {
        None
    }
}
```

Rustls 当前的 `ServerCertVerifier` 要求实现 `verify_server_cert`、TLS 1.2/1.3 handshake signature verification 和 `supported_verify_schemes()`；`WebPkiSupportedAlgorithms` 本身提供 `supported_schemes()`。citeturn490834search5turn899519search1
